body:
The nightmare didn’t end with a presidential pardon.
If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand in the Gap today.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fbed758aed3a4a8f9c2dfd8257e0b3b1&_e=BsaQ3lw5Zq-5q6N_AtQoSB17EPEaZT43wJlNEQ0r2Zk6OusxqSCmLODX2pXqH2fmonbZ_bMF8XITdxurvGHORBRtKtTm4uAHaHzTtAjnQOOdbz5Sq8mBid5YTbMk0y8s4oZChA3G9AEjMjno1L0sJANg0ivlfe3P1Abc2N_7D2Puhbs1Kh1bPgTzqBejO-S736zTz6HQ3c_DUjwbX0WIzeIyLzw5PabaOSHt7LTZ1WxbMyjQpUhLwwppXtmu6pAXcjy1BKIrhkKL7RDyAMDMWFcKdpN0laCyf7-vdHVEzfc-zW6nsU02ycdnQ246zU3P1gm7RhyQJDYIXUksAHpYNSupY9zlkYyFDarfcOd5dRxDo1B2LoJIXKvujLJajJwJ8Zkly-t55xm8pq5US4Wp-eOL7ew_anBx-WWT81VC1P6H_YKEqCc-olaJxVzOCc_Z0tb9QItY--di9_vcsS_LxYOv9ke5B_LSpBU4JEDUd1PFtZZCVAFR1n5ubUw1Rj2Lwx2qXEigoYt71-TGzvlfEd2L5OpbKzIWsbj9NHE97wys1B_lrbysdvvMh-X0TOKP6DzeOK_d7yyN16daGf8CTucYec-aqW5ZwdWNt90pV5PeTadiemBd2g6WZWl3VTxH)

Peter,

Five years ago, I gathered with patriots from all corners of America to protest the certification of the 2020 election results.

All we wanted was for President Trump to get a fair shake, for mail-in vote counts to be redone, and to ensure no fraud had taken place. However, President Trump's enemies saw us coming, and they were ready and waiting to pull off perhaps the biggest psy-op America has ever seen.

Capitol Police officers welcomed many J6ers into the building, with some even providing off-the-cuff tours as they ushered protestors through the halls of the Capitol.

All of a sudden, though, things took a very dark turn...
* A Capitol Police officer murdered Ashli Babbitt.
* Overzealous officers assaulted protestors.
* Rosann Boyland was trampled to death in the panic that ensued as the Capitol Police swiftly turned on peaceful protestors.

For many, like myself, this day marked the beginning of a years-long political persecution that tore families apart, devastated finances, and even denied many of us our freedom and our fundamental human rights.

It also motivated me to start Stand in the Gap -- a commitment to stand in solidarity with and fight for those who are being overlooked or mistreated.

If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand in the Gap today. Peter, Five years ago, I gathered with patriots from all corners of America to protest the certification of the 2020 election results. All we wanted was for President Trump to get a fair shake, for mail-in vote counts to be redone, and to ensure no fraud had taken place. However, President Trump's enemies saw us coming, and they were ready and waiting to pull off perhaps the biggest psy-op America has ever seen. Capitol Police officers welcomed many J6ers into the building, with some even providing off-the-cuff tours as they ushered protestors through the halls of the Capitol. All of a sudden, though, things took a very dark turn... A Capitol Police officer murdered Ashli Babbitt. Overzealous officers assaulted protestors. Rosann Boyland was trampled to death in the panic that ensued as the Capitol Police swiftly turned on peaceful protestors. For many, like myself, this day marked the beginning of a years-long political persecution that tore families apart, devastated finances, and even denied many of us our freedom and our fundamental human rights. It also motivated me to start Stand in the Gap -- a commitment to stand in solidarity with and fight for those who are being overlooked or mistreated. Our goal is to provide support and advocacy for those in need, ensuring they aren't left to face their challenges alone. Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is on helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated. Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative, America First activists, or who supported President Trump. These J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers. It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity. We were founded to "stand in the gap" for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. Our mission is to ensure that every J6er receives the help they need to heal - physically, mentally, emotionally, spiritually, and financially - to reintegrate into society. But they need your help to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity. Sincerely, Shane Jenkins Founder and Executive Director of Stand in the Gap P.S. NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032726_1&amount=25]
President Trump used his recent State of the Union address and the DHS funding debate to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032726_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE AMERICA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032726_1&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032726_1&amount=35]

Lizzie recently sat down with Sarah Longwell of The Bulwark for a wide-ranging conversation about what’s happening in Texas and the path to taking back the House—and we hope you’ll take a few minutes to watch.
They cover everything from Texas redistricting, to the GOP’s push for new seats (and why that strategy could backfire), to the 2026 outlook, the Paxton–Cornyn fight, and why Democrats see a real opening in Texas right now.

body:
| Healthcare tax credits aren’t just numbers on paper.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5283%2E35263%2E0_QNqe)
Team — Do you recognize the little girl in this photo? [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-mar26.vzQga2&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20260327_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=5283%2E35263%2E0_QNqe) That’s me. Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from _any_ insurer. Not at _any_ price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I had a pre-existing condition. That’s why I got into public service. I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that. Now, thanks to the Affordable Care Act, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. That’s in jeopardy because of Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress. Last fall, they created the longest government shutdown in U.S. history to prevent extending the tax credits that millions of Americans, and 275,000 Wisconsinites, rely on to afford their premiums. **I gave them the opportunity to stop health care premiums from doubling with an amendment that would have added an ACA tax credits extension to their funding bill.** **_Every single Republican voted against it._** **[I won’t stop fighting for your health care. Can you pitch in to help me continue this work?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-mar26.vzQga2&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20260327_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=5283%2E35263%2E0_QNqe)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3664?c0=stb-em-mar26.GDK9Ui&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20260327_AM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=5283%2E35263%2E0_QNqe)

body:
They Passed an Income Tax. This Kind of Crazy Tax and Spend Has to Stop.
100,000 Washingtonians opposed it. The constitution prohibits it. Democrats did it anyway.
Friend,
Democrats in Olympia just passed a 9.9% state income tax. The most unpopular bill in Washington State history.
More than 100,000 people signed in to oppose it. Washingtonians have rejected income taxes eleven times at the ballot box. Our state constitution prohibits it. None of that mattered to the majority in Olympia.
I hear from people across Southwest Washington, in Clark County especially, who moved here from Oregon to escape exactly this kind of ever-increasing income tax. They watched Salem pile tax on top of tax, year after year, and they voted with their feet. Now Olympia Democrats are importing the same failed playbook.
These families didn't cross the river to get hit with the same tax burden they left behind.
I fought this bill on the Senate floor. I offered amendments to permanently lock the deduction and let voters have a say through referendum. Democrats voted every one of them down.
Now I'm taking this fight against runaway taxation to Congress, because the same tax-and-spend mindset is alive and well in Washington, D.C., and Southwest Washington deserves someone who will push back.
Our first FEC fundraising deadline is **March 31**. A strong first report sends a clear message: this district will not be taken for granted.
[Donate Before March 31 →](https://votebraun.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18b5086f5b76ceb7f0a23578b&id=7e6766bc8f&e=90b300faf9)
The politicians who passed this income tax are counting on people to forget. Let's make sure they don't.
John Braun

Last night, I joined Erin Burnett on CNN's OutFront, alongside S.E. Cupp to discuss the preposterous participation trophy Republicans just created for President Trump.
Earlier this week, House Speaker Mike Johnson presented President Trump with a golden eagle statue, the inaugural "America First Award," at the National Republican Congressional Committee's annual fundraising dinner.
This isn't what our founders had in mind when they established checks and balances. A co-equal branch of government doesn't commission trophies for the executive.

Peter, If you want to understand why California is in such bad shape, just observe how Gavin Newsom's Attorney General, Rob Bonta, reacts to basic election transparency. As Sheriff of Riverside County, my office is lawfully investigating a MASSIVE discrepancy from the November 2025 special election. Our county logs show a reported discrepancy of up to 45,896 votes, compared to the actual ballots cast. A judge ordered us to count the ballots--not to tally "Yes" and "No." We will simply count the physical ballots and compare this total to the number reported by the Dominion voting machines. However, Attorney General Rob Bonta filed an emergency writ to STOP the count. Thankfully, a Court of Appeal DENIED his request. What is Bonta afraid the Sheriff's Department will discover? I am running for Governor to restore transparency in California. Voters must have total trust in our elections. Without that, there is no democracy. body:
Travelers are stuck in long airport lines. Things that should just work are not working.

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)
---
### Peter —
Right now, people across the country are watching the same thing play out again in Washington, and a lot of them are asking a simple question: why does it always have to be like this? A fight over funding for the Department of Homeland Security has turned into another standoff. Tens of thousands of workers are not getting paid. Travelers are stuck in long airport lines. Things that should just work are not working. This is not complicated. It is a breakdown, and people can see it clearly in their daily lives. But it is also a reminder that we can do better. The DHS shutdown started in mid-February and is still going because lawmakers cannot agree on a funding deal. The impact is not abstract. More than 50,000 TSA workers are working without pay. Hundreds of officers have already quit, and more are calling out. At airports across the country, people are waiting hours just to get through security, and some airports are warning they may have to shut down parts of their operations if this continues. Airport leaders are warning Congress that the situation is getting worse and could have lasting effects. Behind all of this are real people trying to get by. Some TSA workers are sleeping in their cars. Some are picking up second jobs. Some are donating plasma just to make it through. Families are missing flights, and workers are missing paychecks. This is what a broken system looks like. This did not have to happen. This is not some unavoidable crisis. It is a political fight. Lawmakers are arguing over immigration policy and trying to attach other demands to a basic funding bill. Talks have stalled, and each side is blaming the other. On top of that, the White House has pushed to tie this funding fight to the SAVE Act, a controversial voting bill. As a result, funding for airport security and paychecks for workers has been pulled into a much larger political battle. The frustrating part is that this is not what most Americans are asking for. People are not looking for political wins. They are looking for things to work. They want leaders who solve problems, work with others, and get things done. A majority of Americans now say they are independent, not strongly tied to either party, yet our system keeps producing the same kind of gridlock. It does not have to be this way. If there were more independent minded members in Congress, you would likely see deals happen sooner, more focus on real people, and a clearer path out of standoffs like this. Even a small group can make a difference in close votes and help move both sides toward a solution. That is exactly why the Forward Party is recruiting and running candidates for Congress across the country. The goal is not to add more noise, but to change how things work. We are supporting leaders who care more about solving problems than picking sides, leaders who reflect their communities and are willing to work with anyone to get results. Even a handful of leaders like this can break up political standoffs, push for real debate, and represent the millions of Americans who feel stuck between the two parties. This shutdown will end. Funding will get passed, and people will get paid. But the bigger question is what happens next. Do we keep going through this over and over again, or do we send people to Washington who will do things differently? More Americans are ready for that change than ever before, and Forward is working to make it happen. **Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

name: Letitia James
subject: I’m running
body:
I want you to hear this directly from me.
#
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22593?c0=leftnet_em20260327_partner_ms_tish_em_leftnet.ZTkIoG&refcode=em20260327-%7B%7Bmailing_id%7D%5D&t=1&akid=1533%2E2118727%2E4Izwb1)
Hi, it’s Tish James, and I want you to hear this directly from me:
**I’m officially running for reelection as New York’s Attorney General.**
[**Before I share more, will you become a Founding Donor of my reelection campaign by donating to my campaign today?**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22593?c0=leftnet_em20260327_partner_ms_tish_em_leftnet.ZTkIoG&refcode=em20260327-%7B%7Bmailing_id%7D%5D&t=2&akid=1533%2E2118727%2E4Izwb1)
Since 2019, I’ve had the honor of serving the people of New York. I’ve taken on the powerful — from big corporations, to the ultra-wealthy, to powerful politicians like Donald Trump — and delivered real results for New Yorkers.
When the Trump administration pushed their dangerous and immoral policies that target our immigrant neighbors, I fought back because protecting all New Yorkers makes us stronger.
When Donald Trump defrauded the people of New York, I took him to court and held him accountable.
And as Trump and extreme Republicans ramp up their attacks on everything we stand for – threatening immigrants’ rights, raising prices for working people, and launching efforts to roll back voting rights – I’m using the full power of the attorney general’s office to fight back.
That’s why it’s no surprise Donald Trump is targeting me. He knows I won’t stop holding him and his administration accountable, and he’s mobilizing the entire weight of the Department of Justice to come after me because of it.
But if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it's that you can never back down from a bully.
**I’m running for reelection, and I need you on my side to keep fighting for the rights of New Yorkers and people all across this country.**
**[The road ahead is going to be long and expensive, and I’m grateful to have you in this fight with me. Will you make a donation of any amount to my campaign so we can start this race off strong?](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260327_partner_ms_tish_em_leftnet.f0-Fp-&refcode=em20260327-1533&t=3&akid=1533%2E2118727%2E4Izwb1)**
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260327_partner_ms_tish_em_leftnet.f0-Fp-&refcode=em20260327-1533&amount=5&t=4&akid=1533%2E2118727%2E4Izwb1)**
Together, we’ll keep up the fight for justice, progress, and equality.
Thank you,
Tish James
Attorney General of New York

**LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.**
---

## Dems use safety as a bargaining chip...
The Democrats are playing with our national security, and it's downright dangerous.
They're using the TSA as a political pawn in the latest legislative standoff--they'd rather play politics than keep Americans safe.
For 42 days, Democrats have been fighting to block funding for the Department of Homeland Security.
They want to stop funding for ICE, but the collateral damage is thousands of unpaid TSA workers.
It shows how far the left has drifted from the lessons of 9/11.
It's clear the memory and message of that day have faded for them.
If you ask me, this is a reckless move that puts American lives at risk for short-term political gain.
Let's break it down...

His name was **Richard Williams**.
He was 83 years old. A grandfather. A United States Air Force veteran.
On March 8th, he was standing on a New York City subway platform -- waiting for a train -- when a stranger shoved him onto the tracks.
He died from his injuries this week.
The man charged with his murder: a Honduran national with no legal right to be in this country.
I am sickened. And I need you to understand something: **if we don't win this race, it will only get worse.**

Derek Tran voted with the open-borders wing of his party. Every single time. He has never once stood up and said: _enough._

Two hundred fifty years ago, the Declaration of Independence proclaimed the unalienable rights bestowed by our God and Creator. It was the voices of faith--pastors and community leaders--who boldly declared these truths and gave voice to the Christian principles that helped form the foundation of our great nation.
As the story is told, Reverend Jonas Clarke stood among the revolutionary forces on Lexington Green when a British officer commanded, "In the name of the King of England, I order you to yield." Reverend Clarke responded, "We recognize no sovereign but God and no King but Jesus."
Today, we again call on faith and community leaders to proclaim these same truths. Let us stand as proud Christians and proud Americans. May our words echo throughout the community and inspire others to do the same.
To that end, we have formed a Community Action Team called _No King but Jesus_. We meet on the first Monday of each month at the Albert Lea American Legion.
Our mission is to publicly promote Christian patriotism in our community. To accomplish this, we are organizing public prayer events and working to "paint the town" red, white, and blue through the installation of more American flags.
Please consider joining us our community efforts to promote Christian patriotism in our community. name: Jim Jordan
subject: Sick of all the spam
body:
When you see “Jim Jordan” flash across your phone, I want you to know that I mean serious business.
| Friend,
---
**Missed deadlines. Matches. I know you get bombarded with a bunch of spam.**
---
That’s why I save emailing you for times when it’s truly important.
---
_I emailed you when I was sued by the prosecutor who arrested the President._
---
_I emailed you when I learned I was spied on by Biden’s FBI._
---
_I emailed you when we uncovered the truth about Obama’s nefarious plots._
---
When you see “Jim Jordan” flash across your phone, I want you to know that I mean serious business.
---
So here’s the update: I just left a briefing that has me truly worried about the midterms.
---
**_A new survey finds ONLY 61% of Republicans have a real interest in the midterms._**
---
_**If 39% of Republicans stay home and don’t vote, we will be staring down a CATASTROPHIC defeat.**_
---
_Democrats will be grinning from ear to ear knowing that our America First legacy will unravel at the seams._
---
You’re not one of the 39% who’s going to sit out the midterms. The fact that you’re reading this right now proves you’re committed.

**The truth is this: I can’t stand to see all those texts that accuse you of abandoning our Party or suddenly becoming a Democrat. It’s insulting!**

name: Mallory McMorrow
subject: Business as usual is not working
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McMorrow for Michigan
body:
We need to recognize that Washington is fundamentally broken.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4308%2E898137%2EwCfsNi)
We’re in a dangerous reality. But I think it’s important to realize that Donald Trump didn’t create this reality. _He is the result of it._
Because right now, for a lot of people, the American Dream feels impossible. And that’s not new. The American Dream has increasingly been out of reach for _most_ Americans for years. If people feel like it is just that — a dream they can’t achieve — they’re going to give up. Give up on Democrats. Give up on democracy. And yes, even vote for someone like Donald Trump. Because he represents blowing up a system that does not work.
**That’s what happened in 2016. It happened again in 2024. We can’t let it happen again.**
Here’s what I know. We, as Democrats, need to do things very differently. We need to recognize that Washington is fundamentally broken and that people are frustrated not only with the Republicans but with the Democrats too. And honestly? Me too.
**And we have to stop operating like this is business as usual.**
We need leaders who understand that we need to step up, empathize with people, and do what we did in the Michigan State Senate, which is to refuse to accept that we are powerless.
You fight and you win tough races in places where people do not expect Democrats to be. You do this because everybody deserves to feel seen, heard, and understood. They just want somebody who cares about them, who understands them, who’s going to listen to them and do what they can to make their life bettter. And that requires showing up every single day.
Then, when you build that power, you had better do what you said you were going to do to build trust with people.
That’s what I’m running for the Senate to do: _to show up, listen to you, and to work my tail off to do what I told you I would do._
Millions of outside dollars are already pummeling Michigan’s US Senate race, all aimed at buying your vote. I’m not here to do that.
Instead, I’m asking you to support my campaign with a small-dollar donation so I have the resources to get out there and earn Michiganders’ votes.
[**Our first public filing deadline of the year is rapidly approaching. If you’re with me, will you make a contribution of any amount before our deadline hits?**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-mar2026.QSCXFi&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20260327_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4308%2E898137%2EwCfsNi)

\- Mallory

body:
That’s what I said to Congress at an impeachment hearing against the President of the United States.

| | |
---
**“Here, right matters.”**

That’s what I said to Congress at an impeachment hearing against the President of the United States.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7171?refcode=jtk501-bu-nd&t=1&akid=8529%2E400544%2E7bwcWW)
It’s Retired Lieutenant Colonel Alex Vindman. I never intended to be in the national spotlight. I joined the Army and served for 21 years because I wanted to fight and defend the country I love. I could have never expected that it would lead me to testify against the President of the United States.
_That is, until I heard the president try to extort a foreign country into investigating a political rival — a quid pro quo._
I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It was my duty to report the corruption.
I knew that I was assuming a lot of risk by challenging the most powerful person in the world. There was no doubt that he was going to use everything in his power to retaliate, just as he’d done to his opponents in the past.
**[But I had confidence that I could tell the truth. I knew that this is America — and here, right matters. That’s why I am asking you to split a donation between my Senate campaign and Deb Haaland before my end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7171?refcode=jtk501-bu-nd&t=2&akid=8529%2E400544%2E7bwcWW)**
| | [DONATE](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7171?refcode=jtk501-bu-nd&t=3&akid=8529%2E400544%2E7bwcWW)
---
A lot has happened since that day in 2019. President Trump exacted his revenge by firing me and calling me “human scum.” He tried to incite an insurrection to hold onto power after losing a fair election. Now, he is using his powers in office to inflict violence on American citizens.
Amidst all of this, I still believe that right matters.

Our country has lived through challenging periods in the past, but we’ve overcome, persevered, and moved towards a more perfect union.
We are in the middle of another fight for our country right now. I still have faith that good can prevail over evil and that we can overcome these hard times. What is right still matters here ... but only if we make it matter.
**That’s why I have decided to run for the United States Senate in Florida. We are taking the fight straight to Donald Trump in his own backyard. A win here will deliver Democrats control of the Senate.**
**[If you are fired up to win back the Senate majority and finally hold an out-of-control president accountable, then please split a donation between my campaign and Deb Haaland.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7171?refcode=jtk501-bu-nd&t=4&akid=8529%2E400544%2E7bwcWW)**

For our families, for our community, and for our country. Thank you.

— Alex

That is, until I heard the president try to extort a foreign country into investigating a political rival — a quid pro quo. I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It was my duty to report the corruption. I knew that I was assuming a lot of risk by challenging the most powerful person in the world. There was no doubt that he was going to use everything in his power to retaliate, just as he’d done to his opponents in the past. | | A lot has happened since that day in 2019. President Trump exacted his revenge by firing me and calling me “human scum.” He tried to incite an insurrection to hold onto power after losing a fair election. Now, he is using his powers in office to inflict violence on American citizens. Amidst all of this, I still believe that right matters. Our country has lived through challenging periods in the past, but we’ve overcome, persevered, and moved towards a more perfect union. We are in the middle of another fight for our country right now. I still have faith that good can prevail over evil and that we can overcome these hard times. What is right still matters here ... but only if we make it matter. That’s why I have decided to run for the United States Senate in Florida. We are taking the fight straight to Donald Trump in his own backyard. A win here will deliver Democrats control of the Senate. I know how fragile democracy is and I’m ready to continue the fight in the Senate. For our families, for our community, and for our country. Like I said, Fellow Patriot... Damon's story is all too common.

We recently received a request from **Kirstyn Niemela, who spent months living in a camper** in a friend's backyard during the freezing New Hampshire winter.

Because of the stigma of being labeled a J6er, **she has struggled to find stable employment.**

Now, with odd jobs having dried up during the winter months, she's at risk of losing the truck she depends on for transportation and work.

Then there's **Benjamen Burlew, who is now two months behind on his mortgage and electric bill after health issues** wiped out the family's savings.

If they fall any further behind, _**they could lose the home their children have lived in for 17 years.**_

Five years ago, Damon, Kirstyn, and Benjamen were no different than you or me.

They had steady jobs. Loving families. Homes they were proud of. And they believed in President Trump's vision for this nation.

But **the Far-Left turned them into political prisoners ... because _they couldn 't jail all of us._**

clean_body: Dear Fellow Patriot, January 6th was 5 years ago... ...but for many J6 prisoners, their nightmare is still ongoing. Despite receiving a pardon from President Trump, these unjustly jailed men and women are still struggling to rebuild their lives after 4 years behind bars. Like Damon Beckley. After four years as a political prisoner, Damon came home to a life that had been completely destroyed. His family's landlord evicted them from their home, forcing his wife and son to live in an apartment with no heat. And Damon's health collapsed in prison after contracting MRSA and later requiring emergency cancer surgery. To make matters worse, Damon, his wife, and their son are now facing eviction and possible homelessness again. Sadly, Damon's story is far too common among J6 prisoners. In just the last 60 days, for help from January 6 families struggling to survive. Unless we can count on your help, we 'll be forced to TURN AWAY some of these desperate families. Like I said, Fellow Patriot... Damon's story is all too common. We recently received a request from Kirstyn Niemela, who spent months living in a camper in a friend's backyard during the freezing New Hampshire winter. Because of the stigma of being labeled a J6er, she has struggled to find stable employment. Now, with odd jobs having dried up during the winter months, she's at risk of losing the truck she depends on for transportation and work. Then there's Benjamen Burlew, who is now two months behind on his mortgage and electric bill after health issues wiped out the family's savings. If they fall any further behind, they could lose the home their children have lived in for 17 years. Five years ago, Damon, Kirstyn, and Benjamen were no different than you or me. They had steady jobs. Loving families. Homes they were proud of. And they believed in President Trump's vision for this nation. But the Far-Left turned them into political prisoners ... because they couldn 't jail all of us. Now these patriots are trying to rebuild their lives from nothing... and many of them simply can't do it alone. Stand in the Gap is their lifeline. That's why Stand in the Gap exists: to provide emergency financial aid, housing assistance, legal support, and medical help to the men and women who sacrificed everything. But we can only respond to these urgent requests with support from patriots like you, Fellow Patriot. Your support helps provide: Emergency financial aid to prevent homelessness Legal defense funds for ongoing civil lawsuits Medical support for J6ers suffering lasting health problems Basic living expenses while families rebuild their lives January 6th is NOT ancient history, Fellow Patriot. For these families, it's a nightmare they're still trying to escape. Without our urgent help, many of them will NOT survive to the next chapter. Stand in the Gap is their LAST lifeline... and that lifeline exists SOLELY because of generous supporters like you. Thanks for your help, and God bless, Shane Jenkins Founder and Executive Director of Stand in the Gap Stand In The Gap is registered as a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. Based on Revolver News' investigation titled "Great 'Overnight' Replacement: The (Federal) Express Decline and Fall of Collierville, TN," a significant transformation has been occurring in this Tennessee community following FedEx's increased hiring of H-1B foreign workers after securing a substantial federal contract. The article paints a picture of rapid demographic and economic shifts that have residents concerned about their community's future.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.U0T8zSB2CcxcXOskXOn4bmNhiAHfieKtJCfDVDkkydw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=192217226)
According to the report, Revolver News details how FedEx dramatically increased its H-1B visa hiring following a $2.24 billion federal contract award. Data cited in related reports shows the company went from approximately two dozen approved H-1B visa workers to roughly 500 by 2025. This expansion coincided with multiple rounds of layoffs affecting hundreds of American employees across various FedEx locations, including layoffs in Tennessee, Texas, and other states.

In Collierville specifically, the article describes a dramatic change in community dynamics. The article includes resident testimonies highlighting concerns about the sudden demographic shifts: "The H-1B visas have drastically changed the demographics of our small town way too quickly," one resident states. "It is certainly taking its toll on the community; people are starting to move farther out or just leave the area."

The Revolver News investigation suggests this phenomenon isn't isolated to Collierville. A former resident of nearby Cordova reportedly witnessed a similar pattern before moving out of state, claiming: "Almost everyone working in the City of Memphis IT department is an H-1B visa Indian. They did a full purge of their white employees in 2020."

The publication indicates the article is part of a series examining how the H-1B system "built a shadow workforce and labor market inside the reddest part of Tennessee," suggesting a systematic replacement of American workers with foreign visa holders.

FedEx has publicly responded to these allegations, stating they are committed to compliance with all federal immigration laws and emphasize that not all visa approvals result in employment. A company spokesperson noted that FedEx "employs a wide range of roles, requiring a variety of skillsets," and maintained their compliance with all applicable federal immigration laws.

However, the timing of the H-1B increases following the $2.24 billion federal contract has raised questions about whether these foreign workers are replacing American employees rather than supplementing the workforce. The report suggests that American employees were allegedly forced to train their foreign replacements before being terminated, a pattern characteristic of controversial replacement practices.

The Revolver News article claims this situation represents how the H-1B visa program has been allegedly manipulated to create what the publication calls a "shadow workforce and labor market," particularly in politically conservative areas of Tennessee.

While the Revolver News article focuses specifically on the Collierville situation, related coverage has expanded the story to national attention, with discussions appearing on various platforms and social media. Some reports with different perspectives have noted the roles being filled by H-1B workers might be different from those eliminated during company restructuring.

The investigation highlights growing tensions between corporate immigration practices and community stability, particularly in smaller towns like Collierville that experience rapid demographic changes when large employers like FedEx shift their hiring strategies following significant federal contracts.

*Note: This report is based on the [article title and excerpts from Revolver News](https://substack.com/redirect/83db3763-2c24-4b97-ad1c-f9838d0dadbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), supplemented by related coverage of the broader FedEx H-1B controversy.*

FedEx got a $2.24B contract... and Collierville got a 'moving sale' sign. | | | Mar 27 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Based on Revolver News' investigation titled "Great 'Overnight' Replacement: The (Federal) Express Decline and Fall of Collierville, TN," a significant transformation has been occurring in this Tennessee community following FedEx's increased hiring of H-1B foreign workers after securing a substantial federal contract. The article paints a picture of rapid demographic and economic shifts that have residents concerned about their community's future. According to the report, Revolver News details how FedEx dramatically increased its H-1B visa hiring following a $2.24 billion federal contract award. Data cited in related reports shows the company went from approximately two dozen approved H-1B visa workers to roughly 500 by 2025. This expansion coincided with multiple rounds of layoffs affecting hundreds of American employees across various FedEx locations, including layoffs in Tennessee, Texas, and other states. In Collierville specifically, the article describes a dramatic change in community dynamics. The article includes resident testimonies highlighting concerns about the sudden demographic shifts: "The H-1B visas have drastically changed the demographics of our small town way too quickly," one resident states. "It is certainly taking its toll on the community; people are starting to move farther out or just leave the area." The Revolver News investigation suggests this phenomenon isn't isolated to Collierville. A former resident of nearby Cordova reportedly witnessed a similar pattern before moving out of state, claiming: "Almost everyone working in the City of Memphis IT department is an H-1B visa Indian. They did a full purge of their white employees in 2020." The publication indicates the article is part of a series examining how the H-1B system "built a shadow workforce and labor market inside the reddest part of Tennessee," suggesting a systematic replacement of American workers with foreign visa holders. FedEx has publicly responded to these allegations, stating they are committed to compliance with all federal immigration laws and emphasize that not all visa approvals result in employment. A company spokesperson noted that FedEx "employs a wide range of roles, requiring a variety of skillsets," and maintained their compliance with all applicable federal immigration laws. However, the timing of the H-1B increases following the $2.24 billion federal contract has raised questions about whether these foreign workers are replacing American employees rather than supplementing the workforce. The report suggests that American employees were allegedly forced to train their foreign replacements before being terminated, a pattern characteristic of controversial replacement practices. The Revolver News article claims this situation represents how the H-1B visa program has been allegedly manipulated to create what the publication calls a "shadow workforce and labor market," particularly in politically conservative areas of Tennessee. While the Revolver News article focuses specifically on the Collierville situation, related coverage has expanded the story to national attention, with discussions appearing on various platforms and social media. Some reports with different perspectives have noted the roles being filled by H-1B workers might be different from those eliminated during company restructuring. The investigation highlights growing tensions between corporate immigration practices and community stability, particularly in smaller towns like Collierville that experience rapid demographic changes when large employers like FedEx shift their hiring strategies following significant federal contracts. Note: This report is based on the , supplemented by related coverage of the broader FedEx H-1B controversy. As Women’s History Month comes to a close, we’re celebrating the women who didn’t wait for change — they became it.
To every Emerge alum: thank you.
Because of you, leadership looks different today. Stronger. More representative. More connected to the communities it serves.
Right now, there are over 1,200 Emerge alums elected across 36 states — serving at every level of government. From city councils and school boards to state legislatures and Congress, each of you is moving us forward. Every race run, every seat won, and every decision made is part of a larger path being built — one that leads to greater equity and, ultimately, to women leading at the highest levels, including the White House.
Without women in our midst, Emerge doesn’t have the leaders who make this movement possible.
So this month, we invite you to join us:
Sign this virtual card to help us recognize the impact, dedication, and leadership of Emerge alums across the country. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uKtzIIGByEaAVO4A7vItew2]

## Don't Call it a Comeback - The Data--and U-Hauls--Say Otherwise.
Here is what the data actually shows:
* Connecticut ranks roughly middle of the country in annual growth
* It had one strong quarter-- this is not sustained momentum
* The state is losing residents year after year (consistently over the past 3 years)
* Growth is not reaching everyday families, workers, or small businesses

If we were truly a top-10 growth state, people would be moving in--not out.
According to a recent article, for the third year in a row (or during Lamont's current gubernatorial term), more people left Connecticut than moved to the state in 2025, according to U-Haul data. [Source](https://substack.com/redirect/a37f9eb3-edb4-4392-840a-feac0b393ac7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This is a message that [Ryan Fazio is Running on - Turn the U-Hauls Around!](https://substack.com/redirect/d68beec2-7fd4-4d8d-a084-b6476586b442?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**WHAT 'S REALLY HAPPENING**
Connecticut's recent "growth" on paper came from:
* Finance and insurance sector swings
* Timing of large contracts
* Short-term economic rebounds

What it did NOT come from:
* Population growth
* Job expansion at any meaningful scale
* Broad-based economic opportunity

**That 's not a comeback.**
That's a temporary bump.
**THE REAL PROBLEM FOR CONNECTICUT**
We are not keeping:
* Our people including our graduates
* Our work
* Our money

Too often:
* Federal and state dollars come in
* Contracts go to out-of-state firms as most do not qualify for State Contracts [(See a previous article)](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/connecticut-highways-to-h-l-or-just?r=26c3ku&utm_medium=ios)
* Economic benefits leave Connecticut

Meanwhile:
* Residents face rising costs
* Young workers look anywhere but CT
* Local businesses don't see the upside

**THE SOLUTION: ALIGNMENT + ACCOUNTABILITY FROM LOCAL TO STATE TO FEDERAL**
Connecticut can win again--but it takes a shift.
**1\. Keep Federal & State Dollars Local**
* Prioritize Connecticut-based contractors and workforce
* Tie public funding to local economic impact

**2\. Grow Jobs That Stay**
* Expand industries that create long-term employment but that requires a reduction in energy costs
* Align workforce development with real projects

**3\. Reverse Out-Migration**
* Lower barriers to living and working here
* Make Connecticut a place people choose--not leave

**4\. Leadership That Connects all of the Dots**
* State + federal coordination
* Strategic use of infrastructure (and defense funding)
* Focus on results, not headlines

**THE NUTMEG OPPORTUNITY**
Connecticut has:
* A highly skilled workforce
* A prime location between New York City and Boston
* A generally favorable climate
* World-class industries

What we need is leadership that ensures:
_The benefits of growth actually stay here._
**BOTTOM LINE FOR THE GOVERNOR**
One good quarter doesn't make a top-10 economy.
Keeping our people, our work, and our money in Connecticut does.
This November is about either staying the course or reversing the economic curse.

Hey folks,
**Joe Walsh** and I showed up exhausted--not polished, not scripted. Just real. We got into the grind, the burnout, and then zoomed all the way out to what's actually happening politically right now. This one hit that weird intersection of tired and fired up--and yeah, those can exist at the same time.
**Here are a few moments you don 't want to miss:**
* [**00:01:07**] We kick things off raw--talking burnout, the emotional toll of staying in the fight, and why sometimes resistance looks like taking a damn nap.
* [**00:03:03**] I break down why Democrats could be heading into a _wave_ election--and why I'm still not sleeping easy about it.
* [**00:05:26**] The biggest risk? Us. Bad candidates, messy primaries, and the very real chance we overthink our way into losing winnable races.
* [**00:17:05**] California chaos: too many Democrats, not enough coordination--and how that could accidentally hand Republicans the governor's mansion.
* [**00:22:07**] The big picture--why this moment feels like 2006 on steroids, and how anger, the economy, and candidate quality could reshape everything.

This conversation covers a lot--burnout, midterms, candidate strategy, and the uncomfortable truth that voters don't actually like either party right now. It's for anyone trying to stay engaged without losing themselves in the process. And it's a reminder: we can win big and still get it wrong if we don't deliver.
If you value honest conversations like this--the kind that don't pretend everything is fine--help me keep them going.

### **Help us defeat the mainstream media and promote capitalism and American exceptionalism.**
### **[Support The Capitalist, become a paid subscriber today:](https://substack.com/redirect/94bb43b4-abb1-47cd-bafa-8993e9de7427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Support What We Do](https://substack.com/redirect/94bb43b4-abb1-47cd-bafa-8993e9de7427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Maria Corina Machado, the 35-year-old Venezuelan opposition leader speaks with conviction when she says **[Venezuela could one day quintuple its oil production](https://substack.com/redirect/c8ccd1c1-23e5-4b99-9252-a8d8257453b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** under a democratic government. The promise sounds clean, almost seductive. Five times the current output. Millions more barrels flowing from the world's largest proven reserves. It's the kind of headline that makes people sit up and take notice.....but we've heard promises like this before.
Let's be clear from the outset. This is highly speculative.
* **A fully functioning pro-democracy government has not yet been elected in Venezuela.**
* **There is no real timeline for WHEN a fully functioning pro-democracy government will be elected in Venezuela.**
* **The oil production plan itself has not been enacted.**

And even if all these hurdles were cleared tomorrow, history shows these grand transitions rarely deliver the glittering results promised on day one.
* **They take longer,**
* **Cost more,**
* **And usually fall short of the hype.**

Venezuela's oil sector has been hollowed out by years of mismanagement, corruption, and sanctions. Rebuilding it will not be a simple switch-flip.
## **However.**
The geopolitical significance of what is being floated should not be dismissed. Venezuela sits on the largest proven oil reserves in the world -- more than Saudi Arabia. Current production is roughly 1 million barrels per day. If it eventually reached 5 million barrels per day, that would represent nearly a quarter of America's daily consumption (around 21 million barrels) -- and crucially, it would all be sitting right here in the Western Hemisphere, on America's doorstep.
* * *
* * *
### **Help us defeat the mainstream media and promote capitalism and American exceptionalism.[

Support The Capitalist, become a paid subscriber today:](https://substack.com/redirect/94bb43b4-abb1-47cd-bafa-8993e9de7427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Support What We Do](https://substack.com/redirect/94bb43b4-abb1-47cd-bafa-8993e9de7427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Even if that oil were sold on the open market, that geographical shift in the balance of power matters. Millions of barrels of production and accessible reserves would be concentrated in this hemisphere -- far removed from the Strait of Hormuz and the chronic instability of the Gulf. While China remains heavily dependent on Middle Eastern supplies that can be disrupted by conflict or blockade, the United States would be steadily increasing both domestic output and access to nearby sources.
Look at the current production picture in the Americas:
* **[United States](https://substack.com/redirect/0d816049-8b64-4c08-80e0-30a10228c56a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : ~22.8 million barrels per day, massive reserves.
* **[Canada](https://substack.com/redirect/ce1e720f-ade3-47e7-b85b-a550b2796817?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : ~5.9 million barrels, with enormous untapped oil sands reserves.
* **[Brazil](https://substack.com/redirect/a4e287b7-f166-4baf-a9d3-a20deea1cca0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : ~4.2 million barrels and growing.
* **[Mexico](https://substack.com/redirect/0c8080de-ee06-4c18-938c-76ec1b761dba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : ~2 million barrels.
* **[Venezuela](https://substack.com/redirect/57101f73-6fc5-46ea-92e3-0f7a5f8ff9f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : currently ~1 million barrels, with huge potential for far more.
* **[Argentina](https://substack.com/redirect/92d41f58-2bdb-431e-a1c2-0fb9f6edbe4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and **[Colombia](https://substack.com/redirect/57f47e2b-99a5-4574-b756-79d50e4d0e0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : smaller but meaningful producers.

If Venezuela were able to stabilize and ramp up meaningfully, the Western Hemisphere would become one of the most significant oil-producing regions on Earth -- increasingly self-reliant and insulated from the endless turmoil of the Persian Gulf. Machado's plan would put Venezuela on the same footing as Canada who under its current leadership is decidedly less pro oil.
That is not a small thing. The entire global economy is suddenly paying the price for depending on foreign oil and in the case of some nations (looking at you Germany) falling for the fantastical promises that wind and solar could replace oil, gas and nuclear power.

It is fully acceptable to remain skeptical about Machado's timeline and the rosy projections. Democratic transitions are messy. Oil infrastructure that has been neglected for decades does not magically revive. Contracts, investment, rule of law, and basic security all have to be rebuilt. Many countries have tried and fallen short.
But the strategic direction is worth noting. While much of the world remains chained to the volatility of the Middle East, the Americas have the potential to chart a different course. More production, closer to home. Greater energy security. Reduced leverage for distant adversaries.

Whether Machado's vision ever materializes remains to be seen. History teaches caution. But the underlying logic -- that a freer Venezuela could dramatically change the energy map of the hemisphere and thus the globe-- is not fantasy. It is a possibility with real geopolitical weight that a lot of nations (especially Europe) would benefit from and so may be willing to put their hand in their pocket to aid bringing about.
We've seen too many grand promises collapse under their own weight to cheer uncritically. But we've also seen what happens when nations finally get serious about securing their own future.
"Drill baby drill" used to be just a slogan uttered by an Alaskan governor, now it is policy and has filled America's fuel gauge as other nations look on enviously.
Sometimes glittering promises come true.

But we've also seen what happens when nations finally get serious about securing their own future. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? We've seen too many grand promises collapse under their own weight to cheer uncritically. But we've also seen what happens when nations finally get serious about securing their own future. | | | Mar 27| | | ∙| | Guest post ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Help us defeat the mainstream media and promote capitalism and American exceptionalism. Maria Corina Machado, the 35-year-old Venezuelan opposition leader speaks with conviction when she says under a democratic government. The promise sounds clean, almost seductive. Five times the current output. Millions more barrels flowing from the world's largest proven reserves. It's the kind of headline that makes people sit up and take notice.....but we've heard promises like this before. Let's be clear from the outset. This is highly speculative. A fully functioning pro-democracy government has not yet been elected in Venezuela. There is no real timeline for WHEN a fully functioning pro-democracy government will be elected in Venezuela. The oil production plan itself has not been enacted. And even if all these hurdles were cleared tomorrow, history shows these grand transitions rarely deliver the glittering results promised on day one. They take longer, Cost more, And usually fall short of the hype. Venezuela's oil sector has been hollowed out by years of mismanagement, corruption, and sanctions. Rebuilding it will not be a simple switch-flip. However. The geopolitical significance of what is being floated should not be dismissed. Venezuela sits on the largest proven oil reserves in the world -- more than Saudi Arabia. Current production is roughly 1 million barrels per day. If it eventually reached 5 million barrels per day, that would represent nearly a quarter of America's daily consumption (around 21 million barrels) -- and crucially, it would all be sitting right here in the Western Hemisphere, on America's doorstep. Help us defeat the mainstream media and promote capitalism and American exceptionalism. Even if that oil were sold on the open market, that geographical shift in the balance of power matters. Millions of barrels of production and accessible reserves would be concentrated in this hemisphere -- far removed from the Strait of Hormuz and the chronic instability of the Gulf. While China remains heavily dependent on Middle Eastern supplies that can be disrupted by conflict or blockade, the United States would be steadily increasing both domestic output and access to nearby sources. Look at the current production picture in the Americas: : ~22.8 million barrels per day, massive reserves. : ~5.9 million barrels, with enormous untapped oil sands reserves. : ~4.2 million barrels and growing. : ~2 million barrels. : currently ~1 million barrels, with huge potential for far more. and : smaller but meaningful producers. If Venezuela were able to stabilize and ramp up meaningfully, the Western Hemisphere would become one of the most significant oil-producing regions on Earth -- increasingly self-reliant and insulated from the endless turmoil of the Persian Gulf. Machado's plan would put Venezuela on the same footing as Canada who under its current leadership is decidedly less pro oil. That is not a small thing. The entire global economy is suddenly paying the price for depending on foreign oil and in the case of some nations (looking at you Germany) falling for the fantastical promises that wind and solar could replace oil, gas and nuclear power. It is fully acceptable to remain skeptical about Machado's timeline and the rosy projections. Democratic transitions are messy. Oil infrastructure that has been neglected for decades does not magically revive. Contracts, investment, rule of law, and basic security all have to be rebuilt. Many countries have tried and fallen short. But the strategic direction is worth noting. While much of the world remains chained to the volatility of the Middle East, the Americas have the potential to chart a different course. More production, closer to home. Greater energy security. Reduced leverage for distant adversaries. Whether Machado's vision ever materializes remains to be seen. History teaches caution. But the underlying logic -- that a freer Venezuela could dramatically change the energy map of the hemisphere and thus the globe-- is not fantasy. It is a possibility with real geopolitical weight that a lot of nations (especially Europe) would benefit from and so may be willing to put their hand in their pocket to aid bringing about. We've seen too many grand promises collapse under their own weight to cheer uncritically. But we've also seen what happens when nations finally get serious about securing their own future. "Drill baby drill" used to be just a slogan uttered by an Alaskan governor, now it is policy and has filled America's fuel gauge as other nations look on enviously. Sometimes glittering promises come true. * | A guest post by| free markets and American enterprise. You're currently a free subscriber to . With new maps, we’re reaching new communities and building new coalitions across CA-30. That means more organizing, more outreach, and more resources needed right now. Early support will determine how strong we start this election year. **2\. The contrast couldn’t be clearer.**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In an article highlighting the historic number of Gen Z and millennial
candidates running for Congress this year, NPR recently interviewed our
candidate, State Rep. Justin J. Pearson, about why he’s running against a
Democratic incumbent in Tennessee’s 9th congressional district.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260327-1-jp.fIUFN4&refcode=em20260327-37609&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37609%2E1203867%2E4IjMCa ]NPR: A run for their money: Young candidates rival older incumbents in
midterm fundraising

Justin summed it up perfectly: “We need someone who has new ideas, new
energy, and a new perspective to be an advocate for our community. I'm not
running against a person, I'm running against the problem, and the problem
is the status quo."

Only after the article was published did 10-term incumbent Rep. Steve
Cohen provide comment, claiming "[Pearson] sometimes thinks he's the voice
of today and the future. I was that voice 35 years ago..." further proving
Justin’s point!

If you were the voice of the future 35 years ago, then 35 years later,
it’s time to pass the torch.

Cohen has been in elected office for more than 40 years, and lately, he’s
utterly failing to meet the moment. He simply isn’t fighting hard enough
for the working-class people of Memphis or protecting them from Trump’s
fascist siege.

In fact, Cohen voted to thank ICE for "protecting our homeland," and just
this week, he thanked Donald Trump for sending federal agents to terrorize
Memphis.

Meanwhile, Justin has been bold and clear about where he stands:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260327-1-jp.fIUFN4&refcode=em20260327-37609&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37609%2E1203867%2E4IjMCa ]Tweet by Justin J. Pearson: Trump is not welcome to Memphis, Mane! And
he can take his unsafe task force with him when he leaves. We want poverty
eradication and real investment in Memphis, not military occupation.

Memphis deserves a warrior for justice and a champion for democracy who
not only understands the struggles of his working-class, majority-Black
district firsthand, but also has the energy and proven track record of
organizing, mobilizing, and activating people power.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260327-1-jp.fIUFN4&refcode=em20260327-37609&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37609%2E1203867%2E4IjMCa ]Justin can replace this out-of-touch incumbent, but not without a
powerful surge of grassroots support from people like you. Split
$5 or more to Justin’s campaign and Justice Democrats
before his first critical FEC fundraising deadline of the year on March 31
→

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260327-1-jp.fIUFN4&refcode=em20260327-37609&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=37609%2E1203867%2E4IjMCa ]Contribute $5

It’s time for countless establishment Democrats to step aside and pass the
torch to the next generation. Let’s make it happen in TN-09 by giving
Justin what he needs to win in August.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Growing up in Tempe, my family — like so many others — had its fair share of struggles. We faced financial uncertainty, and at times, we had to rely on food assistance and support from our church to make ends meet.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128192303/610541120/683155981?refcode=BLU_EM_UFVF_2026-03-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmY3ODgxNDktMDYyYS1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=lU1IIbOazBxf4A56Qj0DuzkmLFplHitnV6fdw6pz1FE=)
My parents worked hard to provide for me and my twin sister, and we were lucky to have a community that stepped up when we needed it most. That experience shaped who I am today. It taught me the power of public service, genuine caring for your neighbors, and the importance of giving back.

That’s why I started volunteering at my church, then became a social worker, and helped run one of the largest domestic violence shelters in the country. I saw firsthand how families were struggling — not because they weren’t working hard, but because the system wasn’t working for them.

That's what led me to run for office. I refused to accept that so many Arizonans had to fight just to get by while politicians ignored their struggles. So I ran, and I haven’t lost an election since.

Now, as Arizona’s 24th Governor, I’m fighting to make sure no family is left behind. I’m working to lower the cost of housing and healthcare, expand opportunities for working families, and ensure every Arizonan can thrive.

**But I can’t do this alone. Extreme Republicans are working to unseat me and block our progress at every turn, and I need your help.[_Can you split a donation today and help us reach our end-of-month goal? Every contribution — no matter the amount — makes a huge difference._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128192304/610541121/683155981?refcode=BLU_EM_UFVF_2026-03-27_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmY3ODgxNDktMDYyYS1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=lU1IIbOazBxf4A56Qj0DuzkmLFplHitnV6fdw6pz1FE=)**

But before I dive in, my campaign is facing an important fundraising deadline next week. = | = Growing up in Tempe, my family — like so many others — had its fair share of struggles. We faced financial uncertainty, and at times, we had to rely on food assistance and support from our church to make ends meet. = My parents worked hard to provide for me and my twin sister, and we were lucky to have a community that stepped up when we needed it most. That experience shaped who I am today. It taught me the power of public service, genuine caring for your neighbors, and the importance of giving back. That’s why I started volunteering at my church, then became a social worker, and helped run one of the largest domestic violence shelters in the country. I saw firsthand how families were struggling — not because they weren’t working hard, but because the system wasn’t working for them. That's what led me to run for office. I refused to accept that so many Arizonans had to fight just to get by while politicians ignored their struggles. So I ran, and I haven’t lost an election since. Now, as Arizona’s 24th Governor, I’m fighting to make sure no family is left behind. I’m working to lower the cost of housing and healthcare, expand opportunities for working families, and ensure every Arizonan can thrive. But I can’t do this alone. Hi, hey, that's me as a kid, crouched in front of my burned-out house, holding the only two things that survived: a ring and a Jesus medallion.
My house burned down the night before my last high school football game._I borrowed a pair of too-tight football pants and played anyway._
After that, my mom and I moved to the Lehigh Valley to start over. I worked every job you can think of: dishwasher, pizza delivery, bartender, beer truck driver. Eventually, I landed my dream job: firefighter for the City of Bethlehem, PA. Did that for 20 years.

To be honest, we here at Voter Action Project are glad he did. We believe every eligible American deserves to vote in the manner that is easiest for them to participate. That's because we believe that the act of participation is the most important part, not what method you use to cast your ballot.
It's worth noting, however, how he's very willing to use this tool to help himself and make his own voice heard, but he wants to restrict it for everyone else if it seems like it might not benefit him. The pattern is completely clear, and his self-interest drives every decision and statement he makes about voting.
So next time you run into that anti-voting family member, friend, or neighbor, just let them know: Trump himself chose to skip voting in person while in Florida and voted by mail in 2026.
Onward,
The Voter Action Project Team

Peter, Any day now, the Supreme Court will rule on the constitutionality of Louisiana's congressional map in a landmark decision that could also determine the future of the Voting Rights Act (VRA). Right now, the state uses a fair map that allows for two Black opportunity districts where communities can elect a candidate of their choosing. This map was a hard-fought victory, following years of legal battles. But if the court throws this map out (and part of the VRA with it), Black and brown voters across the country may lose their right to equal representation. As horrific as this scenario is, it’s not the full story of the threats to voters in Louisiana. State legislators aren’t even waiting for the Supreme Court decision to start redrawing the congressional map. As we write this, state legislators are already working to create a new map that would silence the voices of communities of color. [**Peter, we need all hands on deck right now to stop the assault on fair maps in Louisiana and across the country. Can you rush us a quick donation to fuel our work?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128193971/610546977/-1096702678?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_LAUpdate_email_20260327-NDRC-Tier1-LAUpdate_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260327-NDRC-Tier1-LAUpdate_&utm_campaign=LAUpdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMxZjQ1NTI5LTA4MmEtZjExMS05YTQ4LTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=hKR-1V-nHaJF9x03H6Lx-Oak7shpp44bLFz6sOsxXI4=) Before the new legislative session started this month, some legislators jumped immediately to a mid-decade redraw. That redraw would eliminate at least one of the Black opportunity districts, diminishing representation for communities of color as part of an attempt to stockpile power for the Republican party. That means that no matter how the Supreme Court rules, we have our work cut out for us protecting fair maps and equal representation in Louisiana. clean_body: We can stop the sneaky redistricting effort in Louisiana, but we need your help | Peter, Any day now, the Supreme Court will rule on the constitutionality of Louisiana's congressional map in a landmark decision that could also determine the future of the Voting Rights Act (VRA). Right now, the state uses a fair map that allows for two Black opportunity districts where communities can elect a candidate of their choosing. This map was a hard-fought victory, following years of legal battles. But if the court throws this map out (and part of the VRA with it), Black and brown voters across the country may lose their right to equal representation. As horrific as this scenario is, it’s not the full story of the threats to voters in Louisiana. State legislators aren’t even waiting for the Supreme Court decision to start redrawing the congressional map. As we write this, state legislators are already working to create a new map that would silence the voices of communities of color. = Before the new legislative session started this month, some legislators jumped immediately to a mid-decade redraw. That redraw would eliminate at least one of the Black opportunity districts, diminishing representation for communities of color as part of an attempt to stockpile power for the Republican party. That means that no matter how the Supreme Court rules, we have our work cut out for us protecting fair maps and equal representation in Louisiana. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = — Team NDRC = = | | Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- National Democratic Redistricting Committee 712 H St NE, #25 Washington, DC 20002 United States if you'd like to receive fewer emails from the NDRC. # _[FINAL HOURS TO VOTE! Voting ends 3/31 at Midnight](https://substack.com/redirect/76f04892-853e-4c79-9c55-e4e1517bf4e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
Dear Valued Subscriber and Movie & Music Lovers,
Disney and Pixar's **HOPPERS** opened as the #1 movie in theatres, with an estimated $46M in ticket sales over the past three days. Among new movies this year, this places it as the second-best opening of the year, behind **SCREAM 7** last weekend which earned $63.6M. Though the cross-over audience between HOPPERS and SCREAM 7 is limited, these movies coming in back-to-back weekends is much appreciated by exhibitors.
The 27 Pixar movies to date have been among the most successful, highest-grossing animated family films in history, with a total box office of $15B worldwide -- a not-too-shabby average of $556M per film. Among Pixar movies, HOPPERS' $46M opening puts it in a league with **RATATOUILLE** , which earned $47M in its opening in 2007. That film went on to earn $206M domestically and $417M globally. Disney would probably be quite satisfied if HOPPERS approaches those same numbers.
Notice I said Scream **7** ... so much for originality. First 6 weren't enough?
**[Vote Now in the Heartland AwardsTM ->](https://substack.com/redirect/c0c62bca-2cca-469b-95c2-78b1427e257f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Our nominees are unique and making waves in the art and entertainment world like never before. Take one example -- Miss **Ella Langley** from Alabama is currently making history with her hit single "**Choosin ' Texas**," leading to her upcoming second album, **Dandelion** (releasing April 10, 2026). "Choosin' Texas" hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, making her one of few women in country history to achieve this, while her success contributes to a historic, record-breaking moment for female country artists.
Langley was chosen to headline "Cowgirls at The Cowboy," the nation's only all-female country music festival, following her breakout success.
Alongside fellow Heartland Award nominee **Megan Moroney** , Langley helped make history in March 2026 as the first women in country music to simultaneously top the Billboard Hot 100 ("Choosin' Texas") and Billboard 200 albums chart.
Add last year's Heartland Award winner **Lainey Wilson** and her 2024 album **Whirlwind** , debuting at No. 8 on the **Billboard 200** and No. 3 on Top Album Sales with 34,000+ copies sold in its first week -- a career high. And **Kelsea Ballerini** 's album **Patterns** is a record-breaking project that debuted at #1 on the Top Country Albums chart, earning her biggest weekly equivalent album units (54,000) to date.
Ballerini's breakout #1 "Love Me Like You Mean It" from her GOLD-certified debut album **THE FIRST TIME** marked the first time a solo female topped the chart in nearly three years since Carrie Underwood's "Blown Away" (2012). She also became the first solo female artist in nine years to hit #1 with her debut country single -- one of only 11 women ever to achieve that feat.
**The message is clear: Heartland voices matter.** These women are making history -- and your vote helps recognize them for it.
