Where Artists Outgrow Their Categories | | | Mar 27 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Dear Valued Subscriber and Movie & Music Lovers, Disney and Pixar's HOPPERS opened as the #1 movie in theatres, with an estimated $46M in ticket sales over the past three days. Among new movies this year, this places it as the second-best opening of the year, behind SCREAM 7 last weekend which earned $63.6M. Though the cross-over audience between HOPPERS and SCREAM 7 is limited, these movies coming in back-to-back weekends is much appreciated by exhibitors. The 27 Pixar movies to date have been among the most successful, highest-grossing animated family films in history, with a total box office of $15B worldwide -- a not-too-shabby average of $556M per film. Among Pixar movies, HOPPERS' $46M opening puts it in a league with RATATOUILLE , which earned $47M in its opening in 2007. That film went on to earn $206M domestically and $417M globally. Disney would probably be quite satisfied if HOPPERS approaches those same numbers. Notice I said Scream 7 ... so much for originality. First 6 weren't enough? Our nominees are unique and making waves in the art and entertainment world like never before. Take one example -- Miss Ella Langley from Alabama is currently making history with her hit single "Choosin ' Texas," leading to her upcoming second album, Dandelion (releasing April 10, 2026). "Choosin' Texas" hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, making her one of few women in country history to achieve this, while her success contributes to a historic, record-breaking moment for female country artists. Langley was chosen to headline "Cowgirls at The Cowboy," the nation's only all-female country music festival, following her breakout success. Alongside fellow Heartland Award nominee Megan Moroney , Langley helped make history in March 2026 as the first women in country music to simultaneously top the Billboard Hot 100 ("Choosin' Texas") and Billboard 200 albums chart. Add last year's Heartland Award winner Lainey Wilson and her 2024 album Whirlwind , debuting at No. 8 on the Billboard 200 and No. 3 on Top Album Sales with 34,000+ copies sold in its first week -- a career high. And Kelsea Ballerini 's album Patterns is a record-breaking project that debuted at #1 on the Top Country Albums chart, earning her biggest weekly equivalent album units (54,000) to date. Ballerini's breakout #1 "Love Me Like You Mean It" from her GOLD-certified debut album THE FIRST TIME marked the first time a solo female topped the chart in nearly three years since Carrie Underwood's "Blown Away" (2012). She also became the first solo female artist in nine years to hit #1 with her debut country single -- one of only 11 women ever to achieve that feat. The message is clear: Heartland voices matter. name: David Hogg
subject: There’s something major happening in Georgia
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
This is too big to ignore.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260327-1&t=1&akid=3297%2E587540%2EtvTHH4)
This kind of thing is too big to ignore, Peter.
**Something major is happening in Georgia.**
In 2024, Leaders We Deserve helped elect **Bryce Berry** , who at the time was the youngest state legislator in Georgia’s history. This year, we did it again when we helped elect **Akbar Ali** , the new record-holder for Georgia’s youngest state legislator. We didn’t just support them because they were young, we supported them because we knew they would be the best fighters for their constituents.
**Akbar has only been in office for a matter of weeks and he is already taking action to make life more affordable for Georgians.** With gas prices surging due to Trump’s illegal war with Iran, Akbar was the _ONLY_ state representative in Georgia who publicly called on Governor Kemp to suspend the state’s gas tax.
After a public pressure campaign and more of Akbar’s colleagues joining him in the fight, the legislature passed the suspension and expects the Governor to sign it into law.
This move alone will save Georgians tens of millions at the gas pump. Akbar is proving that for this next generation of Democrats, affordability is not just a talking point to win elections, it’s an actionable priority they’re uniquely prepared to address.
I spent some time in Georgia lately and met with several inspiring young leaders who will be running for office in the coming years. It’s pretty incredible to see what’s happening there. I remember when it was considered a red state, but now it has two Democratic US Senators and a deep bench of progressives ready to run for the General Assembly, Congress, and other seats of power in the state.
To be honest with you, Georgia is one of the states I am most excited for in the next decade. In my weekly candidate recruitment meetings with my team, the biggest challenge we have with Georgia isn’t finding enough good candidates to run, it's actually that there are often multiple incredible candidates running for the same seat. The state is in good hands, but we need your help to make sure we get the best of the best of our generation elected. Young leaders who reject corporate money, fight relentlessly for their constituents, and inspire the next generation of Bryce Berry’s and Akbar Ali’s to run for office and create lasting change.
Akbar is incredible, but he isn’t in these fights alone. I know there are a ton more candidates out there that can get elected to office in Georgia with our support.
**[We’re going to keep electing bold young progressives in Georgia and across the country. Are you with us, Peter? Donate $5 now to join this fight.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260327_1_georgia.MMvn15&refcode=em20260327-3297&amount=5&t=2&akid=3297%2E587540%2EtvTHH4)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

Friend, Yesterday I wrote to you about four candidates for U.S. Senate and House that we’re fighting to elect to serve alongside me in Congress. But I also need allies on the state level who are rooted in community and understand the needs of their neighbors. My Rooted in Community Leadership PAC is critical to electing local and state leaders who will put our communities’ needs first, not those of corporate and billionaire interests. For example, **Roslyn Ogburn** ―a longtime environmental and housing community organizer and leader in food redistribution―graduated from our Rooted in Community PAC’s Campaign School is running for State Representative. **Lieutenant Governor Garlin Gilchrist** is the highest-ranking Black elected official in Michigan history and is running for Secretary of State. Garlin has consistently called out the toxic influence of billionaire money and corporate PACs in our politics. In addition to supporting candidates for U.S. Senate and House, we’re supporting 10 state-level candidates in Michigan alone who need our help (see the full list below). **But our local support isn’t limited to Michigan. I’ve faced attacks and harassment from some of the most powerful people in the world

Friend — it’s Ilhan.
As you probably know, our FEC fundraising deadline is just a few days away.
[**I’m humbly asking for your support before then. Please allow me to explain.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar26.yyXSzx&refcode=em260327-1-210&t=3&akid=2148%2E791427%2EWUdm5G)

This has never been easy.
I was raised in a refugee camp, immigrated to the US, and found a good life in Minnesota. I got active in my community and eventually earned the privilege of serving and representing my neighbors in Congress.
Since then, I’ve faced attacks and harassment from some of the most powerful people in the world; the President, the Vice President, leading members of Congress, foreign leaders, billionaires, AIPAC, right-wing media outlets and corporations, you name it.
I’ve dealt with the endless death threats, the insults, the people who think I’m not good enough, or not ‘from here’, and want to see me deported or worse.
**But through all of this, I’ve never backed down. Because I have YOU.**
This team and the movement we’ve built together have helped me push through and keep up the fight for the dignity of all Americans.
Because our progressive vision for this nation, where everyone is taken care of and provided the basic human rights and fair shot that they deserve, is worth fighting for, despite it all.
So, with this crucial FEC deadline coming up fast, I’m counting on you to stand by my side as you always have.
[**I’m humbly asking you to make a contribution of $10 or whatever you can afford today. Do it before our deadline closes and we close the books on our fundraising report. | | We had three enormous victories in the Senate this week! It's time to stop for a moment to recognize what's possible when Democrats draw a clear line and fight back. **FIRST, we blocked Trump's attempt to pour more funding into ICE and Border Patrol.** Trump has made ICE into America's secret police. And CBP agents are often worse than ICE agents. Masks. No IDs. Unidentified vans. Breaking down doors without warrants. Ripping citizens out of their cars based on the color of their skin. Detaining folks with no access to attorneys or family — shredding the 4th Amendment that protects us from tyranny. All that has to end. And we will keep fighting for reforms. But we said HELL NO to more ICE funding, and we won. **SECOND, we won the release of the other priorities at DHS that were being held hostage.** For six weeks, Republicans blocked funding for TSA, FEMA, the Coast Guard, and the Cybersecurity Agency. A dozen times, Senate Democrats went to the floor and asked for Unanimous Consent for a bill to fund those four agencies and get paychecks into the employees' hands. And 12 times — including blocking my UC request only two days ago — the Republicans said no. But the bill that passed last night funds all four agencies just as the Senate Democrats have been demanding. **THIRD, we stopped the SAVE Act from moving forward.** This bill is not about stopping noncitizens from voting, it's about stopping CITIZENS from voting — particularly groups that lean blue — women, students, and Tribal members. In short, this bill is Trump's top strategy for rigging the November election. **For sure, these victories are not the end of this fight.** In two weeks, Congress will reconvene, and the Republicans' top goal will be a special type of budget bill — called "reconciliation" — that they can pass in the Senate by simple majority. They will seek to put as much of the SAVE ACT into it as they can — but we will have a good chance to stop many of its most dangerous elements. And of course, they will seek to use that bill to get more funding for Trump's war in Iran, as well as money for ICE and CBP. But we will fight like hell to stop it. name: David Hogg
subject: They called him a punk
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NATE BLOUIN FOR UTAH
body:
| | | | |
---
[|
---](https://goodmancampaigns.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1beed900c689b85fe31d93c8a&id=f9e10beda3&e=30921eb999)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://goodmancampaigns.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1beed900c689b85fe31d93c8a&id=b998f0c2f1&e=30921eb999)
| |
---
| |
Utah Republicans cut off his mic mid-speech on the state senate floor.
Multiple times.
They called him a punk.
Nate Blouin’s response?
_“If wanting a little public accountability from our state leaders makes me a punk, so be it.”_
And he kept going. That’s who Nate is — state senator, defender of Utah’s land and water, and the most consistently outspoken progressive voice in a chamber dominated by a Republican supermajority.
He’s running for Utah’s 1st Congressional District, and his primary is on June 23rd. If he wins, it’ll be history-making: **Nate would be the first progressive Democrat ever sent to Congress from Utah.**
That won’t just be a win for Utah. It’ll be a signal about where the future of the Democratic Party is headed.
[**I’ll tell you more about him and his race in a second, but first, can you split a $5 donation between Nate and Leaders We Deserve today? The earlier we have his back, the stronger his foundation to win his June primary is.**](https://goodmancampaigns.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1beed900c689b85fe31d93c8a&id=ec4501f768&e=30921eb999)
Nate grew up with a deep love for the outdoors. The mountains, the wilderness, the water — that’s not just where he feels at peace, it’s foundational to who he is. Before he got into politics, he spent years working for clean energy companies and environmental organizations, advocating for renewable energy across the Mountain West. And In his first ever race, Nate walked into the Democratic primary and _beat a 36-year incumbent,_ winning by over 50 points.
**His very first bill as a state senator was to save the Great Salt Lake, and he’s still fighting that fight.** The lake is shrinking at an alarming rate, and as the lakebed dries up, it exposes toxic dust that gets blown directly into communities where hundreds of thousands of Utahns live. He’s introduced bill after bill to set measurable recovery goals and protect the lake’s water supply. He’s also passed a law modernizing Utah’s power grid, making it more efficient, easier to add renewable energy in the future, and reducing wildfire risk.
And Nate’s commitment to fighting for working people goes beyond policy. He’s navigated student debt, relied on SNAP benefits to get by, and lived paycheck to paycheck. **Congress needs more leaders like Nate who have actually lived that reality and know what it’s like to navigate today’s economy, not just talk about it.**
And here’s why this race matters:
Utah just went through redistricting battles that created a new seat in Salt Lake County, opening up a rare opportunity for a Democrat to flip a U.S. House seat in Utah. Voters passed a fair map initiative, Republicans tried to kill it, but a court upheld it. **Because democracy worked, there’s a real progressive running in a genuinely competitive seat.**
And just like us, Nate doesn’t take money from corporate PACs or special interests. In Congress, he’ll take on Trump, the billionaires, and the establishment — and he won’t back down.
[**His primary is June 23rd — closer than you think. Putting progressive fighters like Nate in Congress is how we build a Democratic Party that works for all of us. So, can you split a $5 donation between Nate and Leaders We Deserve today?**](https://goodmancampaigns.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1beed900c689b85fe31d93c8a&id=a1ec4bdecd&e=30921eb999)
---
| [DONATE $5 >>](https://goodmancampaigns.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1beed900c689b85fe31d93c8a&id=da91ab20f9&e=30921eb999)
---
| | Thank you, David Hogg
---
|
---
|
---
| **_We deserve better._** Utahns have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to elect a bold progressive fighter to Congress, and we can't let it pass us by. "Politics as usual" is what got us into this mess and we need to try something different. Nate has been silenced on the Senate floor for standing up for his constituents in the State Senate and he's ready to bring that fight to Congress. **This is our chance, let's make it count.** **[JOIN US](https://goodmancampaigns.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1beed900c689b85fe31d93c8a&id=9cd87e5a7f&e=30921eb999)**

body:
The hidden impact of two Colorado bills: Privacy risks few are talking about
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And also, check out our [deep-dive video of the day](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on two dangerous bills moving through the legislator related to privacy.
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers are weighing up to [$1.5 billion in cuts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) amid a growing deficit, including about $198 million from the homestead exemption, while proposals to privatize Pinnacol Assurance are being considered to offset costs. New bills are also [drawing scrutiny over privacy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including device age-verification requirements and measures allowing financial institutions to delay access to funds, raising broader concerns about oversight and personal rights.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** In Commerce City, Turnberry homeowners face potential tax increases tied to a lawsuit over [alleged misuse of bond-related property tax revenue](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while a [$6.2 billion Nexstar-Tegna merger](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has raised concerns about layoffs and reduced local journalism. Broader debates continue over [energy policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [biodiversity credits](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and the [Safe2Tell program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which is seeing record reports but limited transparency on outcomes.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Hakeem Jeffries is facing scrutiny for [reversing his stance on DHS funding](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while the CIA has retracted intelligence reports [flagged for bias](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including one referencing traditional roles. Meanwhile, a federal consent decree will [limit government coordination with social media platforms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the next decade, marking a major development in ongoing censorship and First Amendment disputes.
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, March 27, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The hidden impact of two Colorado bills: Privacy risks few are talking about](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MARIA ORMS, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_When I heard about two bills recently proposed in the Colorado State Legislature, I don’t want to sound overly dramatic—but I felt a real chill._
_Right now, our Constitution and modern technology are on a collision course. We’re being forced to decide how to embrace powerful tools without sacrificing privacy and the rights those tools were never meant to undermine. Consider the debate over Flock cameras in Denver: 400 to 800 people showed up to a community meeting in November, and another 24,000 watched online. People are paying attention—and they’re concerned._
_Yet these new bills are moving forward with little fanfare and even less public scrutiny. Because they deal with technology, they’re easy to overlook—but their potential impact on everyday life is significant. At stake are two proposals: SB26-051, Age Attestation on Computing Devices, and HB26-1110, Vulnerable Adult Financial Exploitation._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Safe2Tell system sees record growth: But outcomes stay hidden](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Safe2Tell reports hit record levels with limited transparency:** The system logged over 3,000 reports in February and nearly 20,000 this school year, but public data does not show how cases are ultimately resolved.
* **Most reports involve safety, bullying, and mental health:** School safety, harassment, and mental health concerns make up the largest share of tips, reflecting ongoing challenges among students statewide.
* **Critics question effectiveness despite rising use:** While reporting continues to grow, lawmakers and observers note that outcomes remain unclear and increased funding has not clearly improved results, raising concerns about accountability and policy effectiveness.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Colorado Lawmakers Weigh $500 Million In Cuts As $1.5 Billion Deficit Looms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Lawmakers weigh major cuts to close $1.5 billion deficit:** Colorado’s Joint Budget Committee is reviewing roughly 150 proposals, including about $516 million in general fund cuts, as the state faces a significant budget shortfall.
* **Largest reduction targets senior and veterans tax relief:** The biggest proposed cut—$198 million—would come from the homestead exemption, which must now be funded from the general fund due to the lack of a TABOR surplus.
* **Additional cuts and privatization plan under consideration:** Proposals include reductions to Medicaid programs, preschool funding, and state operations, while Gov. Jared Polis supports privatizing Pinnacol Assurance to generate roughly $400 million to help offset costs.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Going the wrong way: Colorado’s fentanyl deaths rise while the rest of the nation falls](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | MARCH 25** _While much of the country is finally beginning to turn the corner on fentanyl, Colorado is heading in the opposite direction. And the human cost is staggering. Colorado’s numbers are still moving up—synthetic opioid deaths have climbed 17 percent since December 2024._ ____
**[The Democrats who funded Colorado’s 611% Medicaid overrun are running for Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 24** _Colorado is staring down a $1 billion budget hole. Disabled kids are losing healthcare. Dental benefits are getting capped at $750 a year. Two Democrats who helped create and fund Cover All Coloradans are now asking voters to send them to Congress._
**[Colorado saw red flags in autism therapy billing and approved higher rates anyway](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 23** _Every week, parents of autistic children in Colorado dropped their kids off with behavior therapists they trusted. What they didn’t know—what the state never required anyone to verify—was whether those therapists had passed a background check. Many hadn’t. Not because anyone failed a background check. Because Colorado never required one._**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).

clean_body: I won’t let Trump lie about Portland.| | | = | | For months now, President Trump has been attacking Portland — misrepresenting our city, demonizing our neighbors, and using fear to score political points. And now we know how that narrative has been built. = In other words, the outrage machine is lying about our city to scare people. Trump has relied on this distorted coverage to claim Portland is “like living in hell,” to threaten sending in the National Guard, and to label Oregonians “paid terrorists” and “paid agitators.” But that is not the Portland I know. Portland is beautiful, vibrant, and resilient. It’s where families build their futures and communities come together. Like every major city, we face real challenges — but spreading lies about our city only makes them harder to solve. Portland is a city worth supporting — not demonizing. No matter how long these attacks continue, Oregon will stand together and defend our values. The third No Kings protests are tomorrow. The fight to protect democracy is a long-haul. | |
---
Peter, **“No Kings” is definitely about Trump** —the wannabe dictator has started an illegal war with Iran, deployed ICE agents to terrorize our communities, reshaped our economy with no Congressional approval, and taken every opportunity to abuse his power. But the fight to defend democracy doesn’t end when Trump leaves office. **That’s because we’ll still have the self-ordained kings and queens on the Supreme Court, and the powerful elites waiting in the wings to become our next authoritarian ruler.** Trump wouldn’t be allowed to act as a king in America without the warped and corrupted system that put him there. It’s the same system that transferred power and money to those at the top and stacked the Supreme Court with loyal extremists. **The elites and extremists pulling the strings have a lot of power. But when we stand together as We the People, we can be even stronger.** [**That’s why we’re bringing the mass movement for court reform out to the streets tomorrow, March 28th. Find a No Kings event near you and join us!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbIwXrUx9efdTq_vbf4FLD27L3aJZ766y3MaCay2AIbg/4pa/kEu2NeftTOOXMQ_voxGlFQ/h0/h001.9Jjc5QITotu00orzhlqGqKqOWH5xyPEwK0925Ck5UvM) [****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbIwXrUx9efdTq_vbf4FLD27L3aJZ766y3MaCay2AIbg/4pa/kEu2NeftTOOXMQ_voxGlFQ/h1/h001.azX0dlNJvviCCJ77_AE2DtBTVWW_P3WjT-BAmQ7-I4k) [JOIN US](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbIwXrUx9efdTq_vbf4FLD27L3aJZ766y3MaCay2AIbg/4pa/kEu2NeftTOOXMQ_voxGlFQ/h2/h001.esIrOC0MayEXMBWIdDoeb7DZuAyHDahF9k5X2gJvCYk) Donald Trump is just one man. The MAGA Supreme Court justices are a small handful. The powerful elites that built the system that props him up are also few. **But We the People are millions strong, and the Constitution and our democracy belong to us, not them.** **Remember, every single thing we care about is affected by Trump and the Court’s attacks on our democracy.** Immigration, trans rights, abortion rights, the environment, healthcare, and beyond—for the first time we’re bringing together organizations fighting for ALL of these issues to demand court reform. **We can’t fix America without fixing the courts. There’s too much at stake to limit this fight to accountability for Donald Trump.** We’ve got a long, tough fight on our hands. Those wealthy elites waiting in the wings to warp our democracy and abuse power won’t give up without a fight, and they have a lot of resources. But we have people power, and we know the strength we have when we stand together. [**Come out to the No Kings protests tomorrow and stand shoulder-to-shoulder with us in our fight to save democracy! Find an event near you now.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbIwXrUx9efdTq_vbf4FLD27L3aJZ766y3MaCay2AIbg/4pa/kEu2NeftTOOXMQ_voxGlFQ/h3/h001.eHVzf0uyX7WtkJadElpY2_8HlRAWCCGzxySWx2b-sIY) Thank you for fighting for democracy, Morgan Stahr

**When Nancy was 17, she dropped out of high school.** Most kids in that situation fall apart. **But not Nancy.** **I raised her to believe that setbacks don’t define you -__how you rise does.__ ** She grew up hearing the same lessons over and over again: **
👉** Never quit.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | Hi, This is Brigadier General James Emory Mace, U.S. Army (Retired). Today, I write to you not as a soldier... but as a father. I’m a Vietnam War Veteran and Purple Heart Medal recipient. I’ve worn the uniform. I’ve buried friends who never made it home. And I’ve felt the sting of a Nation that sometimes forgets what our sacrifices were for. But my daughter - Congresswoman Nancy Mace - never forgot. Nancy was raised in the shadow of the flag. She saw the uniform. She lived with the deployments. She knew the cost. And instead of running from it, she ran toward it. That’s the kind of person -the kind of fighter \- she is. When Nancy was 17, she dropped out of high school. Most kids in that situation fall apart. But not Nancy. I raised her to believe that setbacks don’t define you -how you rise does. She grew up hearing the same lessons over and over again: 👉 Never quit. 👉 Never run from the truth.👉 And never let anyone tell you thatyou are less than what God made you to be. So I gave her a choice: She picked herself up, took a job at Waffle House, and fought her way back. By 21, she became the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, following in my footsteps. Soon after, she was elected as the first woman to represent South Carolina in the U.S. House of Representatives. She’s been fighting her whole life; for herself, for her kids, for the truth, and now...for her state. Nancy led an evacuation mission in the Middle East after learning a South Carolina family was stranded. Because when your people are stuck in a war zone getting hit with missiles and rockets, the only answer worthy of the office -worthy of our country \- is to get them out. She flew into an active war zone and answered the call when Americans needed help. As a father - and as a Purple Heart Veteran \- I’ve never been more proud of my daughter. That’s why it’s hard when I have to watch Nancy face relentless attacks day after day. Each day that goes out there and fights for you, she’s up against the Establishment’s knife. They stalk her. Twin Lakes-Elkhorn Crest by Robin Coen
Dear Peter,
OLCV’s biggest event of the year is less than a month away! Tickets are on sale for OLCV’s Annual Celebration for the Environment, a night dedicated to protecting Oregon’s environment and celebrating the progress we’ve made together.
OLCV’s Annual Celebration for the Environment
Friday, April 24th, 2026
The Loft on 8th, Portland, OR
Doors at 5:30
Get your tickets [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/aa6cd270-8751-11e9-a741-3fcfcb35cbb0]
This year, we’re celebrating major climate victories, like the passage of 1.25% for Wildlife, and rallying our community for the work ahead.
Here’s what to expect:
* Delicious food
* Oregon wine and beer
* A welcoming community of environmental advocates
* A chance to win your choice of three exclusive travel packages
* Inspiring remarks from two climate champions: * Congresswoman Andrea Salinas
* Washington County Commissioner Nafisa Fai

It’s going to be an inspiring and energizing night. I hope you’ll join us.
Buy your tickets now [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/aa6cd270-8751-11e9-a741-3fcfcb35cbb0]
Bonus! Here’s a sneak peak of the three exclusive travel packages that you’ll have a chance to win:
* 4 nights at a coastal Cabo resort
* 3 nights in Jackson Hole
* 3 nights glamping in the Grand Canyon

subject: Infrastructure investments are about more than roads and bridges.

body:
$17.5M for Skagit Transit, $183M for transportation projects across Washington, nearly $4M for flood protection, and more
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128199731/610564253/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTI2YzcyYS0xNDJhLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3CiT7eAXDoUUB596Df5A2V7lfd0E-KiyYsGQ-UD6IKo=&emci=bce41118-5e22-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=7926c72a-142a-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=9494239)

| | This month, we made some meaningful progress in improving our infrastructure and bringing opportunities back to Northwest Washington. **After years of work, federal grants will improve rail corridors, modernize bridges, and support cleaner transportation, totaling over $183 million for Washington state communities.** These investments will strengthen supply chains, reduce landslide disruptions, and make streets safer throughout Northwest Washington, including:
* $17.5M for Skagit Transit's facility in Burlington
* $16M to support the Northwest Seaport Alliance's transition to zero-emission trucks
* $3.84M to reduce landslide blocking events and improve Pacific Northwest Rail Corridor reliability at three locations between Seattle and Everett
* $6.45M to improve the Puget Sound Rail Corridor
* $14.78M for Pierce Transit's new depot with conductive charging infrastructure for battery-electric buses
* $51.65M for the Hood Canal Bridge girder replacement
* $25.65M to support the City of Seattle's Safe Streets initiative

Grants originally requested in 2022 to protect Whatcom County homes from devastating floods were approved. **Nearly $4 million will help elevate homes in Sumas, Ferndale, and Everson to prevent future flood damage. This funding helps families recover and protects communities from future disasters.** **Finally, Washington will participate in a national program to test advanced air mobility aircraft. This initiative will help create good-paying aerospace jobs and reinforce our region's leadership in aviation innovation.** These wins mean federal dollars returning home. They mean construction projects, aerospace innovation, and stronger infrastructure across Northwest Washington. They also show what steady work in Congress _can_ deliver for our communities. This is just the beginning for Northwest Washington's infrastructure and job creation opportunities this year. **In February, I requested $10,160,295 for ten projects. Funding for those projects is included in the FY26 spending package. These dollars are transforming the region from the ground up:**
* $4M total for the Pepin Creek FASST project in Lynden to prevent flooding, protect farmland, and restore salmon habitat
* $4M total for Snohomish County's Intermodal Yard to expand rail capacity and strengthen regional commerce
* $2M to modernize Community Transit with clean electric buses
* $2M to create a new community hub for low-income families in South Everett
* Over $3M combined for critical community infrastructure, including domestic violence survivor services, the Port of Edmonds seawall, and Bellingham's Central Library
* Additional investments supporting food access, tourism, and economic development in Edmonds, Everett, and Anacortes

This is what it looks like when federal resources come home: cleaner transit, safer communities, stronger infrastructure, and real economic opportunity. Northwest Washington is not just receiving funding—it is being positioned for long-term growth, resilience, and prosperity. [**Now, I need your help to keep the momentum going. Our end-of-quarter deadline is approaching, and your support helps ensure we can continue fighting for investments that bring jobs and opportunity to our region.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128199732/610564254/1596212816?refcode=2026-03-27-eoq&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7926c72a-142a-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTI2YzcyYS0xNDJhLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3CiT7eAXDoUUB596Df5A2V7lfd0E-KiyYsGQ-UD6IKo=) Your support now will help me continue the work of delivering results for Northwest Washington. That’s why we showed up, alongside many WFP electeds and Tax Billionaires, Fund PA Bill sponsors Representatives Krajewski and Fiedler. And that’s why this campaign is growing. Wednesday wasn’t just a rally — it was momentum. We’re already seeing more lawmakers step up and engage, and the conversation in Harrisburg is shifting because people like you are demanding it. But moments like this only matter if we build on them. [**👉 Tell your legislators: Tax Billionaires. This is about whether people in our communities can afford to survive. Pennsylvania is home to more than 20 billionaires (and countless large corporations) who continue to benefit from tax breaks and loopholes that let them pay far less than their fair share. That’s why we showed up, alongside many WFP electeds and Tax Billionaires, Fund PA Bill sponsors Representatives Krajewski and Fiedler. And that’s why this campaign is growing. Wednesday wasn’t just a rally — it was momentum. We’re already seeing more lawmakers step up and engage, and the conversation in Harrisburg is shifting because people like you are demanding it. But moments like this only matter if we build on them. Sending a message takes less than a minute, but right now, as budget decisions are being made, it can have a real impact. Lawmakers need to hear that this wasn’t just one day of action. We have the resources to fund our schools, protect healthcare, and invest in our communities. What we’re missing is the political will to make the wealthiest pay their fair share. Now let’s keep going — and make sure Harrisburg doesn’t forget it. 🇺🇸 AMERICA
WON'T BACK DOWN Strength deters. Appeasement invites aggression.
---

Friend, The Democrats and the media are doing what they always do — second-guessing American strength. They forget that President Trump's first-term maximum pressure campaign **made America a net energy exporter** for the first time in generations. We were finally free from our dependence on Middle East oil. Gas prices fell. American energy workers thrived. While past presidents shipped cash to Tehran and begged for deals the Iranians never intended to keep, President Trump imposed sanctions that collapsed their economy. When they killed their own people in the streets — tens of thousands of peaceful protesters — he didn't look away. He acted. **That's called courage.** And it's exactly what's missing from the Democrat Party. I worked for the U.S. State Department alongside our troops in Iraq and Afghanistan. I know the stakes when America projects weakness. Our enemies don't negotiate — they exploit. President Trump understands that, and I'm proud to have his back in Congress. **Our end-of-quarter deadline is March 31. Will you chip in to support leaders who believe in American strength?**

Our elections are worth protecting |
#
---
Washington Republicans are threatening our elections, Team. Last month, President Trump suggested nationalizing Michigan’s elections, sending federal agents to take over polling places from local clerks. And now, we’re seeing new efforts in Washington that could take us further backward. The Senate is set to vote on the _SAVE America Act_ , a proposal I believe would make it harder for eligible voters to participate and interfere with how states administer their own elections. Here’s what I have to say: **not on my watch.** Our nation’s constitution outlines and protects our right to fair, free elections. Any attempt to undermine that goes against our long, proud history of a strong democracy. In Michigan, more than 1,600 Republican, Democrat, and Independent clerks work with the Secretary of State to make sure every vote is counted. _That is what our nation is about, making sure everyone has a chance to make their voice heard. _ This November, we will once again run a safe, secure election, and we will honor the will of the people. We will move forward together — **no matter who tries to stand in our way.** **[Our end-of-quarter deadline is coming up on Tuesday, and your support right now is especially important. clean_body: Our elections are worth protecting | Washington Republicans are threatening our elections, Team. Last month, President Trump suggested nationalizing Michigan’s elections, sending federal agents to take over polling places from local clerks. And now, we’re seeing new efforts in Washington that could take us further backward. The Senate is set to vote on the SAVE America Act , a proposal I believe would make it harder for eligible voters to participate and interfere with how states administer their own elections. Here’s what I have to say: not on my watch. Our nation’s constitution outlines and protects our right to fair, free elections. Any attempt to undermine that goes against our long, proud history of a strong democracy. In Michigan, more than 1,600 Republican, Democrat, and Independent clerks work with the Secretary of State to make sure every vote is counted. That is what our nation is about, making sure everyone has a chance to make their voice heard. This November, we will once again run a safe, secure election, and we will honor the will of the people. Dear friend, Thank you for your generous support of my campaign. It will take all of us to retake the majority. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you about another partner, whose endorsement I recently earned again: **Council for a Livable World.** They are the oldest political organization dedicated to reducing the risks of nuclear war, correcting years of wasteful Pentagon spending and championing a diplomacy-first foreign policy. The Council’s mission and endorsement matter deeply to me and I am honored to have them on our team!

[**The bottom line is this: Council for a Livable World’s work to elect to Congress people like me who want to get rid of nuclear weapons makes all of us safer. If you can, please make a donation today to help power this important work.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128202979/610574043/1607716093?refcode=em-3.27.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTJiYmIwOC0xYjJhLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9Qd-oHYgc9eeXyMdhzwqiFVZ1IKTJWn8cSDXt41zR6M=)

If we’re going to take back Congress, push back against dangerous foreign policy outcomes and step back from the brink of a new nuclear arms race, we need help.

Hi friends —

If you’ve been on my email list for a while, you’re probably used to hearing from me with updates about what’s happening at City Hall: what decisions are being made, what they mean, what it all means for you, and ways you can stay involved.

Running a statewide campaign for Lieutenant Governor means the updates look a little different... but the spirit of them is the same. So here’s the honest update.

Over the past few weeks, I’ve been traveling across Rhode Island, meeting folks in living rooms, community centers, and neighborhood events to talk about what people want from their next Lieutenant Governor. I’ve been hearing a lot about affordability, housing, climate resilience, and **the simple desire for government to actually work for regular people.**

**If you know me, you know that’s exactly why I’m in public service.** And conversations like these are the most important part of this campaign.

That means it is my number one priority to build a team that can make this happen by knocking doors, making phone calls, coordinating events, visiting communities across the state, and making sure we can keep showing up wherever Rhode Islanders want to talk.

And that’s where I’m hoping you might be able to help.

We’re approaching the end of our first fundraising quarter of the election year, and these early months are when we’re laying the foundation for the campaign ahead, including growing our team.

**[If you’re able, would you consider making a contribution to help us keep this work going? My team tells me we need to raise $8,000 more before our reporting deadline of midnight on March 31. Can you help? Team,

Republicans have wanted this seat back ever since we flipped it in 2022. I’m the first Democrat in a CENTURY to hold this longtime Republican stronghold, and now they believe they have an opening.

MI-03 is the only blue district in West Michigan, surrounded by red. This makes our race **absolutely critical** in the fight to take back the House, and Republicans know it.

Earlier this month, I officially filed to be on the ballot in Virginia. Running for reelection is not a decision I made lightly, so I wanted to take a few minutes today to explain why I got in this race [_**– and why I need your help before Tuesday’s end-of-quarter deadline.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128203942/610576933/-1948452084?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOQ3_260327_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNGY1OTNkMi0xZDJhLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bg7t5FtcQZVnCY8c0qJhbFLzYcnlb32gvFdvbGMqnck=) ******[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128203943/610576934/-1948452084?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOQ3_260327_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNGY1OTNkMi0xZDJhLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bg7t5FtcQZVnCY8c0qJhbFLzYcnlb32gvFdvbGMqnck=)****** Now, I want to be honest with you, this last year has been one of the most challenging I’ve seen during my time in public service:
* We watched as the president and his friends in Congress slashed health care for working people to pay for tax cuts for those already at the very top.

* We’ve seen reckless tariffs drive up prices at the store and slam the door on export markets for Virginia farmers and businesses.

* And perhaps most troubling of all, we’ve seen an impulsive and inconsistent foreign policy that is willing to put American servicemembers in harm’s way.

**The challenges facing our country right now are big. There’s no question about that.**

I am running for reelection because I believe in this country. I believe in its promise. And I still believe that the world is better off when America leads the way. I’m also running because I believe in something that’s deeply personal to me: That everyone in this country should get the same fair shot at success that I had.

**_That’s what this campaign is about._**

And this year, we have one mission. And it’s simple. We have to win. We have to win big. And we have to win by such a large margin that no matter what nonsense Donald Trump throws at us, there is no doubt where Virginia stands.

And frankly, we can’t afford to fail. That’s why this upcoming end-of-quarter deadline is so important – and it’s why I’ve got to ask:

Amidst all of this I still believe that right matters.

Our country has lived through challenging periods in the past but we’ve
overcome, persevered, and moved towards a more perfect union.

We are in the middle of another fight for our country right now. I still

My team and I just had an emergency meeting to discuss our own ad budget. It's ambitious, but we need to reach all the Ohioans we possibly can with our message of hope and strength. With my opponent reserving $10 million worth of ad space, getting more time on the airwaves is a must. We can’t afford to stay quiet and allow Vivek to soften his extreme past. | Since we launched this campaign over a year ago, I've been traveling across the state talking with hardworking Ohioans. The sentiment is almost always the same: they're ready for change. They're ready for someone who understands them and will stand up for the real issues they face. I've been there. As a child, I often wondered where my next meal would come from or whether the bills would be paid. I'm running for governor so no Ohioan has to feel that way, Derek. But Vivek Ramaswamy has a very different vision for Ohio. One where billionaires like him profit, and life gets worse and more expensive for the rest of us. Derek: He thinks he can buy this seat. We can’t let that happen. Senate Caves on ICE Funding

The Senate unanimously passed a deal early Friday to fund most of DHS -- including TSA, the Coast Guard, and FEMA -- but caved to Democrat demands by stripping all funding for ICE and parts of Customs and Border Protection, 42 days into the [shutdown that paralyzed](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGSpSAURL9GMyxFATcg2MTsbbqhBdyL3BoES1Dn86feRBNP1kl39Tn_X-vLUKS0_TM7anfTChnWE4_LRnImFWdurBlwL5QgrLznkvUj42pNcR1a0A7kyFvUg1KTnIQahzZoKZzrAf6ISQmUgxq89aCkRLRW8tm2pN9L_cgVH_p5mjuchUfphZu9sNaYZuqvA0zF0rmcCp63qXQjpZTfKafO5b2NOtR6lGb82_Cl4cvzPJ3Pnwmfd21v-HLkSJVcafgCobASrgr5ScyeaD5qOPO1BebyjoW5XCr7gc78lYDSxjxtoRaW0JyFYYL21HA8FCMVqZqp33ZD8ftP_YXCW_OvAAAA___yvIXZ) airports nationwide. Senate Appropriations Chair Susan Collins said Democrats "remained intransigent and unreasonable" and warned their refusal to fund immigration enforcement "sets a precedent they may one day [come to regret](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LGO4yAYBOCngY4IfhvwFRTXuMu1V1oYfsIvYbACcV5_lS32AbYbaUZfMf_v291Tofr45w904aIttrg98XzthYKvPfgLR4t4dKoxbyDBCDkJsFstm-LRhWgm4OiUtbOZtZ0Uz05DShGV-gM2yn03JqhFozLeBoQZEyf3keQEFpRc5uWGi05okg5L0vvuPZvl64x-YL-FVjs-Lz_oQqq1fVKrt9AOXlwe4-xs-stgZbCOjJlK-XQM1twOrPjuDNaO1Q9ksOpFThasGN2LmLtIrxqpPgQFFD8j_nTxfFMp1I1ls3wcnr5RPn7x0eXgKwAA__-yo3bH)." Democrats got no reforms to ICE operations -- but Republicans lost ICE funding from the annual budget entirely. The House Freedom Caucus immediately slammed the deal, calling it an abdication of responsibility and demanding ICE funding and a voter ID provision be added to the bill. Republicans vow to restore ICE funding for up to a decade through budget reconciliation. ★★★ Iran Rejects U.S. Peace Plan

Tehran flatly rejected President Trump's 15-point ceasefire proposal and issued a defiant five-point counterproposal demanding war reparations, guarantees against future strikes, and full [sovereignty over the Strait](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL3upCAUxZ8GOydwFXELim3sZtstzRWu400QCDBO9u03ziP8u5Ocr-T397k-kQPH1x88ybqLV5_8Wii_t8AOY3V4UUuezsrRHytImHo59GDWGFbVeev8NEBHVhkzTqM2g-oOS7sGGB2hmhR6JTcyciDY0Ck9buQ6tveSHMCAkvM4P2jWO027dvOutw1RjPKdPTaqD5dipXJh44s4xnSrFB8unV2wR2u5iuG3gEXA0g46OITbE7DkFNj9E7BwbFTit4ZBwKJnKZX51XPB2Kd9p1J7l953KpeUU8XQf7D0FL2ApSvW5w-HwHUyYpSvE_l70bUfELss_A8AAP__Kd59Iw) of Hormuz. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told state media Iran has no plans to negotiate and "does not want a ceasefire." The rejection came as Iranian drones struck a fuel tank at [Kuwait International Airport](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGu5CAQRE-DM0a4zWBvQLCJs7_phlYbmk9LGJBhPNdfefYGP2m1qqRXpfr7tX0hJ87ff_Ag6y7efPHbSfW1J3aYm8OLevF0NM4-bqDASDVJmLectnHw1nkzwUB2nGdt9HOexiFabcKitN4dOvBGBT9OBgHCryloA3sY2N4kNcEMo1r08qDlGciEp1vCc98RhVav6rFTe7iSG50Xdr6Icy73V_LDlWNINvZem5h-C1gFrD1S5JRuT8Aay0GZ3k3AivVzJOdOZ_4AMP2XeiSZ7qAuX03Ws9TSqElH2CjwSbImzBKb7GcptclI6GUv8mDvE0nC1gWsw2l9fXNK3MwstPo-kD89hv6DWS8L_wIAAP__YrCK-w) and Israel launched fresh airstrikes on Tehran. The Pentagon is deploying over 1,000 paratroopers from the 82nd Airborne to the region as both sides [harden their positions](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGOrDAQRE9jMo9MG4MncPATsvnphqixm6ElYyNsWO3tV8wRNivpqaqk9_WaXsiR0_s_buT8xVPIYTpoP-fIHlPxeFHNgbbCKawTKOil0hKGKcWpbYLzodfQkGuHoes7M-i2WR15mj117VMTwQydBU2WyASl8elnbNjdS0rDAK2ynX2QNQv1i_F2MfOMKDp17gErlYfPqdBxYeWLOKV8p5wePm9NdGutexH6n4BRwFhXWjnGmwkY9xzZ_wgYOVU60qeGUcBorGqNsfIskg9Mcs-Fb1jkxiFEkoSlSk9YaOGD5H6WVcDYHC7s3xwjl34QnXpvyJ-vpv5B3eXgNwAA___7E4Cn). ★★★
DOJ Purges Trump Case Workers

Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche announced at CPAC that every DOJ and FBI employee involved in the criminal investigations of President Trump has been fired, resigned, or taken early retirement -- more than [200 people in total](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LGOhCAYBOCnwY4NooJbUFxjt9deaX7hV7jAjxF0s29_2X2E66b5JpP5ecwPCDHQ9g0Jjb3C7LKbD9zPJQYLVCxcWLPDVAI5P0shFRcdl3qmOLeNM9apTjZoWq171Q-6axtvhBvE4rRWC66r6ttB9ne7Wqe0cGN7hyaYd5PopJatGPvxhuOwoloHO67DsgCwXpy7g4rlZjMVPC6o4cJAlN8p083m1ETja90L676YnJicfs9Sq0fC55slJqctX3hQQqpMTis6PCBy2JBswMLktEQg65EXeBVejzPtHFwKxD0UbiMCoeM-nwU_qhaOaY_5hVj40-fmMG5_hhhDUZr1YksQ4mda_cebl5F_AQAA__9WSok3). "There is not a single man or woman at the Department of Justice who had anything to do with those prosecutions," Blanche declared, adding that FBI Director Kash Patel has likewise cleaned house at the bureau. The purge follows the firing of a dozen agents tied to the classified documents probe and multiple [lawsuits from terminated agents](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHOpCAUhZ8GOyaIImxBsY3dbLulgXuv490gGGGc1984j_B3Jzn5zkm-v8_lGThxfv0JO3m4eMGCy0nHOyaGkCuEi1pB2itn3Bat9CTVILVdclr6Dj3gNOiOfG_tOI3GDn23-REcQrBqdL8MGLeiig7XGK2doO9j7NjfS2rQVvfKje5Bzqw0rQbcamIMQYzqfWBoVB9QcqXzCo0v4pzLnUp-QNm75LfWjiqG30LPQs9to41Tujuh563slOlThZ4D7py5tvPLCj0bp7Qxg2wFUcYUMmwk4QggsfyTa2S58sn5dcPd6fH4cEpcJytG9doDfz-69gNll9f_AwAA__9l93zX) claiming wrongful termination.

_Forwarded Message from Scott Peters:_

Peter,

I’m facing my first FEC deadline of the year in just a few days, and we’ll be releasing all of our fundraising numbers for everyone to see. The stakes are too high for us to fall short at this major test. At a time when San Diegans are struggling with the rising cost of living, we’re seeing misplaced priorities in Washington. clean_body: | | | | | This and always, we honor all the women who have shaped California’s history—from the trailblazers and history-makers, to the activists, neighbors, non-profit leaders, moms, business owners, caregivers, artists, scientists and innovators. This year, California made history with Senator Monique Limón being elected the state’s first Latina and first mom to serve as Senate President pro Tempore. And today, a historic number of women are serving in the California Legislature, leading on the issues that matter most and delivering for our . with purpose, courage and conviction. Earlier this year, California’s own, Speaker Nancy Pelosi, announced her retirement after nearly four decades of dedicated leadership and public service. Because of leaders like Speaker Pelosi–the women who spoke up when their voices were disregarded and who dared to be the first when the path forward seemed impossible–California moves forward. Tune in to a special conversation with Speaker Nancy Pelosi and CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks as they reflect on her historic career and the road ahead for Democrats: "Keeping it Real with Rusty ft. Hi Peter, One of Chaz’s favorite parts of the campaign trail so far has been something you might not expect. The dogs. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Yz2js-H1KJlQfRoUo-gKww~~/AAUS1hA~/hp3dSL8kglJ5D10z_2C4AWwgUakeEGIH4DCygp-Ic7VhIjmPoRulVBNOeYj6R0a46VJjw9JfDtZLAs3djtbK9Pu1wM3oW7gpITO-smpG7UNqVS4LlCXvzfbZsNpkqd05aHckZFPuNc8Ix55lSxYFnVMH50JmwrgGiUuSbf58lyFZV1Mu6SlCT05jB7f4iI_LrO6uP6zorCya6VEtVq_a9Q5UTi8C5TpHS-XgxS_1Bgrda3-byzTOd8tAiS_u5k-l) Wherever he goes — neighborhood stops, local events, meeting folks across TN-5 — there’s usually a dog nearby. As we head toward our first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the year, we’re focused on making sure this campaign has the resources to keep showing up across TN-5. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. On March 15, TOP members proudly joined San Antonio residents, organizers, and partner organization ACT4SA [https://act4sa.org/] at Greater Faith Institutional Church for the rededication of the restored “Say Their Names” mural [https://www.tpr.org/criminal-justice/2026-03-16/san-antonios-say-their-names-mural-restored-two-months-after-vandalism-on-mlk-day] . The rededication brought together organizers, advocates, and community leaders to reaffirm the mural’s purpose, as well as our shared continued call for true accountability in our legal system and justice for all.

name: Oregon Department of Justice
subject: Town Halls in Roseburg & Gresham - and more updates from DOJ
body:
| | | |
---
|
# The Oregon Department of Justice is fighting for Oregonians every day.
|
* * *
---
The Oregon Department of Justice exists to serve you: to keep Oregon communities safe, fight for seniors, children, and working families, and uphold our state's laws and values. Our recent work has put money back in the hands of working families, taken perpetrators of child sexual abuse off our streets, and challenged corporate monopolies that would raise prices for all of us.
Read on for more:
* Share input at town halls in Roseburg & Gresham
* Set up a new tool to protect your privacy
* Learn how the Supreme Court is standing with Oregon and working families
* and more!

It's an honor to serve Oregonians alongside the great team at the Oregon DOJ.
Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General
| |
* * *
---
|
---
# Town Halls in Roseburg (3/31) and Gresham (4/8)
Our work at DOJ is directly informed by your input and feedback — because we're here to serve you. That's why we're traveling the state to hear from you about the issues that matter most, like keeping communities safe, fighting for working families, and upholding Oregon's values. Join us in**Roseburg next Tuesday, March 31** ([RSVP here](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fforms.office.com%2FPages%2FResponsePage.aspx%3Fid=R5oHZGLPEk2_1R5x3945wlHVbZlv4G9PnGU0a9dd6XlUQlQwVTZDVkQ1TDY1SkJLSkFPVk1OUUY2WC4u/1/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/yy5ej8LseMrOIiZJPdsIrAW_QD-i2uffqYBubl_EWYQ=450)) and in **Gresham on Wednesday, April 8** ([RSVP here](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fforms.office.com%2FPages%2FResponsePage.aspx%3Fid=R5oHZGLPEk2_1R5x3945wlHVbZlv4G9PnGU0a9dd6XlUQUo5M1hXMFg2V0JBRFlKREFLVFVXWUMyRC4u/1/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/Q_xwNqxUSidG_bSFUkiLyft8a1TbhiXbSpO5mIwprl4=450)).
---
| |
* * *
---
|
# New privacy tool: Universal Opt-Out
We are working to protect Oregonians' privacy every day. As of January 1, Oregon residents can use a **Universal Opt-Out tool** to prevent personal data from being sold, shared, or used for targeted advertising. Universal Opt-Out is a virtual "signal" on your internet browser that automatically tells websites to not sell or use your data for targeted advertising. [Learn how to set up Universal Opt-Out.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fcontent.govdelivery.com%2Fattachments%2FORDOJ%2F2026%2F01%2F28%2Ffile_attachments%2F3536009%2FDOJ_Opt%2520Out%2520Handout_2026.pdf/1/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/_zce0WI4wBBL6l-K1Kobow09oIgfUNaj70mlY0-js18=450)

# Keeping communities safe from pollution
We are leading a multistate coalition to keep our communities safe from pollution and to prevent the worst impacts of climate change. Recently, the Environmental Protection Agency repealed the landmark finding that greenhouse gas emissions contribute to climate change. We are leading the coalition challenging this action. [Learn more.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2F2Rnc_-LnmUo/2/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/a_rXmtyKDgUUTYBgM-pCyE8D8uXNQH2RKE_Y83rX9EU=450)

# Protecting Oregon's kids
**We are working every day to keep our communities safe — and that includes Oregon's children.** The Internet Crimes Against Children (ICAC) Task Force at the Oregon Department of Justice focuses on investigating, prosecuting. and preventing the sexual exploitation of children on the internet. Just this month, our ICAC team arrested a man in Lakeside on charges of child sexual abuse material, and secured sentences for two more people in Coos County on similar charges. [Learn more](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-announces-icac-arrest-two-sentencings-in-child-exploitation-cases%2F/1/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/7LrPYV4HJeqQFs4LL7SPyjdsRk3l_XXBdtjKi3TmeAY=450).

# Taking action on immigration
**Every Oregonian deserves to feel safe in our communities.** We have heard from thousands of Oregonians sharing fear and anger about unlawful immigration enforcement in our communities. We have responded by taking dozens of legal actions to protect Oregonians from unlawful federal overreach with regards to immigration enforcement. We've also created toolkits and resources based on community needs and feedback, and a portal for Oregonians to report federal overreach so on-the-ground facts inform our legal work. [Learn more](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Foregon-department-of-justice%2Ffederal-oversight%2Fimmigration-actions%2F/2/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/mcmkFFkKm_Ux1GJ-UtS7f9BSOL3YUdk2FJzwRZ4FKIU=450).

# Win for working families at the Supreme Court
Oregonians work hard for every dollar we earn — so when the president tried to unlawfully increase prices on groceries, utilities, and basic everyday necessities, we took action. Last month, **in a win for working famlies and small businesses, the U.S. Supreme Court[si](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fstatement-from-ag-rayfield-on-supreme-court-tariff-victory%2F/1/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/UTKVQ02YhjSqnJMlQJBmKb_FaPjo8o8chJXsfEWeR4s=450)[ded with Oregon](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fstatement-from-ag-rayfield-on-supreme-court-tariff-victory%2F/2/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/w9jSWRuKt22xQ6l0fG6sRrXQHszE1ePUb1QOmJQ98js=450) to overturn the president's unlawful tariffs.** We are continuing to fight for working families and small businesses across our state. [Learn more](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-files-court-order-to-stop-trumps-illegal-tariffs%2F/1/0101019d314c4bf0-ccf15a71-22e4-41d2-9b48-27791e6c96bb-000000/9awhRASU3J58ko6CJk7Jg6i6TfPZp5a7esSuIM0aRk8=450).

# Federal Oversight & Accountability Town Hall
We work collaboratively with other state Attorneys General to fight back against unlawful federal overreach. This work has brought $4.6 million dollars back in to Oregon communities for things like disaster preparedness, funding for victims of crime, and SNAP. In January, we hosted a town hall on the anniversary of our first multistate lawsuit. # Barron Trump reports assault, attacker jailed for four years
A 22-year-old Russian man was sentenced to four years in prison **[after Barron Trump reported witnessing him](https://substack.com/redirect/4fc217b1-1bb7-4c36-943f-6a5c4777a472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** assault a close female friend during a video call from London, with the victim crediting the call for saving her life.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4fc217b1-1bb7-4c36-943f-6a5c4777a472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Russian Citizen Convicted Assault:** Matvei Rumiantsev beat the woman while the call was active, calling her a "slut," "whore," and "not worth anything" in an attempt to assert dominance, driven by jealousy over her friendship with Barron Trump.
* **Violence Spanned Months:** The assault began months earlier due to jealousy, with Rumiantsev ensuring the beating was captured on camera during the video call answered instead of by the woman.
* **Barron Acts Responsibly:** Barron Trump immediately called London police after witnessing the attack; the judge noted he acted "properly and responsibly," despite the dispatcher accusing him of being rude.
* **Victim Thanks Barron:** The unnamed woman told the court Barron's call was "like a sign from God" and believed it saved her life; Rumiantsev was convicted of assault and attempting to pervert justice but cleared of rape and strangulation charges.

# Iranian hackers leak Kash Patel's private photos and emails
FBI Director Kash Patel **[was hacked by Iranian-linked operatives](https://substack.com/redirect/14596b10-d763-49f3-9b1d-99e2a92565ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who leaked his personal emails and vacation photos online, with the Handala Hack Team mocking U.S. security after the breach tied to recent strikes on Iran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14596b10-d763-49f3-9b1d-99e2a92565ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hackers Claim Victory:** The Handala Hack Team published Patel's emails from 2010-2019 and photos of him vacationing in Cuba sniffing a cigar, reclining with rum, and posing at a bar in Puerto Vallarta, declaring America's security collapsed.
* **Retaliation Message:** Hackers responded to the FBI's $10 million reward and domain seizures by saying Patel's compromise shows the FBI has "no real security," brought to its knees within hours after U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran.
* **Photos and Context:** Images include Patel next to a vintage car, a bronze statue, and with his girlfriend Alexis Wilkins; the breach followed Justice Department action against the pro-Palestinian group believed linked to Iran.
* **Government Response:** A Justice Department official confirmed the emails were hacked; the FBI offered rewards and warned of retaliatory attacks since President Trump ordered strikes on Iran on February 28.

| Dear Friend,
I want to tell you exactly what happened the morning my team walked into Skid Row disguised as homeless people. Within minutes — **minutes** — a woman named Brenda Brown walked up, pinned a $20 bill to a man's shirt as a signal to the crowd, and started handing out cash. Not for a day's work. Not for a service rendered. **For his signature on a California ballot petition. And then — because he wasn't yet registered to vote — cash again to register him right there on the spot.[**Watch the video for yourself here:**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=35")** ******[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=25")** "I'm paying you guys," Brenda said. "I need to get paid too." That moment is now on federal record. Because what Brenda Brown did — paying someone to register to vote — is a **federal felony under 52 U.S.C. §10307** , punishable by up to **five years in prison** and a $10,000 fine. And it didn't happen once. **We documented it 28 times. In a single investigation. In just a few days.** [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-mb-om/?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs&utm_medium=om&utm_campaign=mb&utm_term=22710_wr1")******[ → YES, James — I'll chip in $35 right now to help expose what's next](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. **Here's the full story — and why it matters to every American who votes:** For months, paid petition circulators have been operating openly in broad daylight on Skid Row in Los Angeles — targeting the most desperate people in America. They get paid **$5 to $10 per signature** — sometimes earning over **$1,000 a day** — to gather signatures on California ballot initiatives funded by corporations like **Uber, Delta Air Lines, United Airlines** , and the American Hotel & Lodging Association. But here's where the fraud metastasizes: they weren't just collecting signatures. They were coaching homeless men and women to sign using **fake addresses like "Pinocchio Lane."** They were pressuring people who had **no idea what they were signing**. And they were handing out **cash, cigarettes, and marijuana** to make it happen — all violations of California Elections Code §18603. And it gets worse. Our investigation revealed something even more chilling: these petitioners were giving the homeless **printed lists of real registered voters' names and addresses** and instructing them to forge those voters' signatures. Thousands of times. We tracked down the real voters. One homeowner told us: **"Doesn't live here. I bought this house nearly nine years ago. The only reason I know that name is because we still get her mail."** He said he always felt strange receiving her ballot. That woman's vote — **your vote — is being forged on Skid Row for $2 and a cigarette.** [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-mb-om/?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs&utm_medium=om&utm_campaign=mb&utm_term=22710_wr1")******[→ Donate $100 now — help us expose every player in this scheme before Part III drops](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cash-for-sigs-hf?utm_source=omg-cash-for-sigs&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=25")** **But this isn't just about crooked petitioners. This goes straight to taxpayer-funded institutions.** Directly across the street from where all of this was happening sits the **Weingart Center** — a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that received **$112 million in government grants in 2022 alone** and holds over **$800 million in net assets**. Its executives are paid between $400,000 and $600,000 a year. A Weingart Center employee named Kathy appeared on our hidden camera — **directing our undercover journalist to exactly where the fraudulent petitioners would be operating**. Another employee, intake coordinator Jason Warren, told us when and where to find the cash exchanges and explained how the money accounting worked. He called it routine. A separate employee coached a homeless signer on **plausible deniability** : "They say ignorance is no excuse for the law. But a lot of times I have to say, 'I didn't know. I had no idea.'" When our journalists tried to document all of this, a worker from LASA — the **Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority, the primary funding body for Weingart** — approached us, falsely identified himself as LAPD to intimidate us, then reversed course when we told him impersonating a police officer is a misdemeanor under California Penal Code 538D. Law enforcement officers sitting nearby dismissed the cash exchanges as a "civil matter." **This is industrial-scale election fraud, and the institutions built to serve the vulnerable are operating as the cover.** [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) believes there are many examples of how the Democratic Party has been co-opted by the radical left in America.

The senator has grown impatient with her colleagues on the other side of the aisle for being so unwilling to make a deal and fund the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

DHS is the lone major agency that was not funded by Congress when they enacted the full-year FY2026 spending for most of the rest of government.

“Look, this is just completely unnecessary and unfortunate in so many ways,” Britt said Sunday on Fox News. “We have men and women who have stepped up to serve our Department of Homeland Security. We’re seeing TSA right there, and they’re not getting a paycheck. It’s unacceptable. We want our Democratic colleagues to sit down with us and find a pathway forward...The first time they sat down with us was on Thursday.”

Britt and Warnock hosted HBCU presidents from around the country in Washington, D.C.
